arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He only commands you to commit vice and wickedness, and to attribute to GOD what you do not know.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا يَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلسُّوٓءِ وَٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَأَن تَقُولُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Their example is like those who start a fire, then, as it begins to shed light for them, GOD takes away their light, leaving them in darkness, unable to see.
arabic_uthmani: مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When they are told, “Follow what GOD has revealed herein,” they say, “We follow only what we found our parents doing.” What if their parents lacked understanding, and were not guided?
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَآ أَلْفَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ ۗ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The example of those who disbelieve is like those who parrot what they hear of sounds and calls, without understanding. Deaf, dumb, and blind; they cannot understand.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى يَنْعِقُ بِمَا لَا يَسْمَعُ إِلَّا دُعَآءً وَنِدَآءً ۚ صُمٌّۢ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, eat from the good things we provide for you, and be thankful to GOD, if you do worship Him alone.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لِلَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He only enjoins you from eating dead animals, blood, the meat of pigs, and animals dedicated to other than (their Creator) GOD. If one is forced (to eat these), without being malicious or deliberate, then he incurs no sin. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةَ وَٱلدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ بِهِۦ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَلَآ إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who conceal what GOD has sent down of the scripture, and sell it for a cheap price, eat but fire into their bellies. GOD will not speak to them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them. They have incurred a painful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْتُمُونَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَيَشْتَرُونَ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۙ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مَا يَأْكُلُونَ فِى بُطُونِهِمْ إِلَّا ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: It is they who bought the straying at the expense of guidance, and the retribution at the expense of forgiveness. Therefore, they will have to endure Hell.
arabic_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَٱلْعَذَابَ بِٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ فَمَآ أَصْبَرَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: This is because GOD has revealed this scripture, truthfully, and those who dispute the scripture are the most ardent opponents.
arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ نَزَّلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Righteousness is not turning your faces towards the east or the west. Righteous are those who believe in GOD, the Last Day, the angels, the scripture, and the prophets; and they give the money, despite loving it, to the relatives, the orphans, the needy, the traveling alien, the beggars, and to free the slaves; and they observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat); and they keep their word whenever they make a promise; and they steadfastly persevere in the face of adversity, hardship, and persecution. These are the truthful; these are the righteous. Equivalence is God’s Law*
arabic_uthmani: لَّيْسَ ٱلْبِرَّ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ قِبَلَ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلْبِرَّ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَءَاتَى ٱلْمَالَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ ذَوِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَٱلسَّآئِلِينَ وَفِى ٱلرِّقَابِ وَأَقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَى ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱلْمُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِهِمْ إِذَا عَـٰهَدُوا۟ ۖ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ فِى ٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَحِينَ ٱلْبَأْسِ ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, equivalence is decreed for you when dealing with murder; the free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female. If one is pardoned by the victim’s kin, an equitable compensation shall be paid. This is an alleviation from your Lord and mercy. Anyone who transgresses beyond this incurs a painful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْقِصَاصُ فِى ٱلْقَتْلَى ۖ ٱلْحُرُّ بِٱلْحُرِّ وَٱلْعَبْدُ بِٱلْعَبْدِ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۚ فَمَنْ عُفِىَ لَهُۥ مِنْ أَخِيهِ شَىْءٌ فَٱتِّبَاعٌۢ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَأَدَآءٌ إِلَيْهِ بِإِحْسَـٰنٍ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ تَخْفِيفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ ۗ فَمَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَهُۥ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Equivalence is a life saving law for you, O you who possess intelligence, that you may be saved.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْقِصَاصِ حَيَوٰةٌ يَـٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Deaf, dumb, and blind; they fail to return.
arabic_uthmani: صُمٌّۢ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: It is decreed herein that: when death approaches you, you shall write a will for the benefit of your parents and relatives, equitably. This is a duty upon the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ إِن تَرَكَ خَيْرًا ٱلْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ وَٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۖ حَقًّا عَلَى ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If anyone alters a will he had heard, the sin of altering befalls those responsible for such altering. GOD is Hearer, Knower.
arabic_uthmani: فَمَنۢ بَدَّلَهُۥ بَعْدَ مَا سَمِعَهُۥ فَإِنَّمَآ إِثْمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَدِّلُونَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If one detects gross injustice or unreasonable bias on the part of a testator, and takes corrective action to restore justice to the will, he commits no sin. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: فَمَنْ خَافَ مِن مُّوصٍ جَنَفًا أَوْ إِثْمًا فَأَصْلَحَ بَيْنَهُمْ فَلَآ إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, fasting is decreed for you, as it was decreed for those before you, that you may be saved.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Specific days {are designated for fasting). If one is ill or traveling, an equal number of other days may be substituted. Those who can fast, but with great difficulty, may substitute feeding one poor person for each day of breaking the fast. If one volunteers (to feed more poor people), it is better. But fasting is the best for you, if you only knew.
arabic_uthmani: أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍ ۚ فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ فَعِدَّةٌ مِّنْ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُۥ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ ۖ فَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَن تَصُومُوا۟ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Ramadan is the month during which the Quran was revealed, providing guidance for the people, and profound teachings, as well as the statute book. Those of you who witness this month shall fast. Those who are ill or traveling may substitute the same number of other days. GOD wishes for you convenience, not hardship, that you may fulfill your obligations, and to glorify GOD for guiding you, and to express your appreciation. God Responds to “His Servants ”
arabic_uthmani: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ فِيهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَـٰتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَٱلْفُرْقَانِ ۚ فَمَن شَهِدَ مِنكُمُ ٱلشَّهْرَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ مَرِيضًا أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ فَعِدَّةٌ مِّنْ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَ ۗ يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُمُ ٱلْيُسْرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ ٱلْعُسْرَ وَلِتُكْمِلُوا۟ ٱلْعِدَّةَ وَلِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When My servants ask you about Me, I am always close. I answer the prayers of any of them when they pray to Me. They shall respond to Me, and believe in Me, that they may be guided.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Permitted for you during the nights of fasting is sexual intercourse with your wives. They are the keepers of your secrets, and you are the keepers of their secrets. GOD knew that you used to sneak around and cheat your souls; He has redeemed you and pardoned you. Now, you may have intercourse with them, seeking what GOD has decreed for you, and eat and drink until the white thread of light becomes distinguishable from the dark thread of night at dawn. Then fast until the night. Do not have sex with them if you retreat to the mosque (during the last ten days of Ramadan). These are GOD’s laws; do not transgress them. GOD thus clarifies His revelations for the people, that they may be saved.
arabic_uthmani: أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ ٱلصِّيَامِ ٱلرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَآئِكُمْ ۚ هُنَّ لِبَاسٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لِبَاسٌ لَّهُنَّ ۗ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَخْتَانُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَفَا عَنكُمْ ۖ فَٱلْـَٔـٰنَ بَـٰشِرُوهُنَّ وَٱبْتَغُوا۟ مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَكُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ ٱلْخَيْطُ ٱلْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ ٱلْخَيْطِ ٱلْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ ٱلْفَجْرِ ۖ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا۟ ٱلصِّيَامَ إِلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَلَا تُبَـٰشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنتُمْ عَـٰكِفُونَ فِى ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدِ ۗ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَقْرَبُوهَا ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall not take each others’ money illicitly, nor shall you bribe the officials to deprive others of some of their rights, illicitly, while you know.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَأْكُلُوٓا۟ أَمْوَٰلَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَتُدْلُوا۟ بِهَآ إِلَى ٱلْحُكَّامِ لِتَأْكُلُوا۟ فَرِيقًا مِّنْ أَمْوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They ask you about the phases of the moon! Say, “They provide a timing device for the people, and determine the right times for Hajj.” It is not righteous to beat around the bush,* but righteousness is to uphold the commandments and to be straightforward. You shall observe GOD, that you may succeed.
arabic_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْأَهِلَّةِ ۖ قُلْ هِىَ مَوَٰقِيتُ لِلنَّاسِ وَٱلْحَجِّ ۗ وَلَيْسَ ٱلْبِرُّ بِأَن تَأْتُوا۟ ٱلْبُيُوتَ مِن ظُهُورِهَا وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلْبِرَّ مَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰ ۗ وَأْتُوا۟ ٱلْبُيُوتَ مِنْ أَبْوَٰبِهَا ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Or, like a storm from the sky, with darkness, thunder, and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears, to evade the lightning bolts, and death. GOD thus surrounds the disbelievers.
arabic_uthmani: أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَـٰتٌ وَرَعْدٌ وَبَرْقٌ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطٌۢ بِٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall fight in the cause of GOD against those who attack you, but do not aggress. GOD does not love the aggressors.*
arabic_uthmani: وَقَـٰتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَكُمْ وَلَا تَعْتَدُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You may kill those who wage war against you, and you may evict them whence they evicted you, for oppression is worse than murder. Do not fight them at th Sacred Mosque, unless they attack you therein. If they attack you, you may kill them. This is the just retribution for such disbelievers.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱقْتُلُوهُمْ حَيْثُ ثَقِفْتُمُوهُمْ وَأَخْرِجُوهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ أَخْرَجُوكُمْ ۚ وَٱلْفِتْنَةُ أَشَدُّ مِنَ ٱلْقَتْلِ ۚ وَلَا تُقَـٰتِلُوهُمْ عِندَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ حَتَّىٰ يُقَـٰتِلُوكُمْ فِيهِ ۖ فَإِن قَـٰتَلُوكُمْ فَٱقْتُلُوهُمْ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If they refrain, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You can also fight them to counter oppression, and to worship GOD freely. If they refrain, do not aggress, except against the aggressors.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَـٰتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ ٱلدِّينُ لِلَّهِ ۖ فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوْا۟ فَلَا عُدْوَٰنَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Even during the Sacred Months, any aggression shall be met by an equivalent response. Thus, if they attack you, you may counter attack to inflict an equitable punishment Observe GOD, and know that GOD is with the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلشَّهْرُ ٱلْحَرَامُ بِٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْحُرُمَـٰتُ قِصَاصٌ ۚ فَمَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱعْتَدُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ مَا ٱعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall spend in the cause of GOD; do not throw yourselves with your own hands into destruction. You shall be charitable; GOD loves the charitable.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تُلْقُوا۟ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ إِلَى ٱلتَّهْلُكَةِ ۛ وَأَحْسِنُوٓا۟ ۛ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall observe the Hajj and ‘Umrah pilgrimage for GOD. If you are prevented, you shall send an offering, (and observe the rituals wherever you are). Do not resume cutting your hair (the last ritual) until your offering has reached its destination. If you are ill, or suffering a head injury (that forces you to cut your hair), you shall expiate by fasting, or giving a charity, or some other form of worship. During the normal observance of Hajj, if you break the state of Ihraam between ‘Umrah and Hajj, you shall expiate by offering an animal sacrifice. If you cannot afford it, you shall fast three days during Hajj and seven when you return to your homes—thus completing ten—provided you do not live at the Sacred Mosque. You shall observe GOD, and know that GOD is strict in enforcing retribution.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَتِمُّوا۟ ٱلْحَجَّ وَٱلْعُمْرَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ فَإِنْ أُحْصِرْتُمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ ٱلْهَدْىِ ۖ وَلَا تَحْلِقُوا۟ رُءُوسَكُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ ٱلْهَدْىُ مَحِلَّهُۥ ۚ فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوْ بِهِۦٓ أَذًى مِّن رَّأْسِهِۦ فَفِدْيَةٌ مِّن صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ ۚ فَإِذَآ أَمِنتُمْ فَمَن تَمَتَّعَ بِٱلْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى ٱلْحَجِّ فَمَا ٱسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ ٱلْهَدْىِ ۚ فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَـٰثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِى ٱلْحَجِّ وَسَبْعَةٍ إِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ ۗ تِلْكَ عَشَرَةٌ كَامِلَةٌ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَن لَّمْ يَكُنْ أَهْلُهُۥ حَاضِرِى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Hajj pilgrimage shall be observed during specific months.* Whoever sets out to observe Hajj therein shall abstain from sexual intercourse, misbehavior, and arguments throughout Hajj. Whatever good you do, GOD is fully aware thereof. As you prepare your provisions for the journey, remember that the best provision is righteousness. You shall observe Me, O you who possess intelligence.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلْحَجُّ أَشْهُرٌ مَّعْلُومَـٰتٌ ۚ فَمَن فَرَضَ فِيهِنَّ ٱلْحَجَّ فَلَا رَفَثَ وَلَا فُسُوقَ وَلَا جِدَالَ فِى ٱلْحَجِّ ۗ وَمَا تَفْعَلُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ يَعْلَمْهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَتَزَوَّدُوا۟ فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ ٱلزَّادِ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ وَٱتَّقُونِ يَـٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You commit no error by seeking provisions from your Lord (through commerce). When you file from Arafaat, you shall commemorate GOD at the Sacred Shrine. You shall commemorate Him for guiding you; before this, you had gone astray.
arabic_uthmani: لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَبْتَغُوا۟ فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۚ فَإِذَآ أَفَضْتُم مِّنْ عَرَفَـٰتٍ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عِندَ ٱلْمَشْعَرِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ۖ وَٱذْكُرُوهُ كَمَا هَدَىٰكُمْ وَإِن كُنتُم مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall file together, with the rest of the people who file, and ask GOD for forgiveness. GOD Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَفِيضُوا۟ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَفَاضَ ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: This scripture is infallible; a beacon for the righteous; (1) The Righteous.
arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The lightning almost snatches away their eyesight; whenever it lights for them, they move forward, and when it turns dark, they stand still. If GOD willed, He* could have taken away their hearing and their eyesight. GOD is Omnipotent.
arabic_uthmani: يَكَادُ ٱلْبَرْقُ يَخْطَفُ أَبْصَـٰرَهُمْ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَضَآءَ لَهُم مَّشَوْا۟ فِيهِ وَإِذَآ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوا۟ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Once you complete your rituals, you shall continue to remember GOD as you remember your own parents, or even better. Some people may say, “Our Lord, give us of this world,” while having no share in the Hereafter.
arabic_uthmani: فَإِذَا قَضَيْتُم مَّنَـٰسِكَكُمْ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَذِكْرِكُمْ ءَابَآءَكُمْ أَوْ أَشَدَّ ذِكْرًا ۗ فَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَـٰقٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Others would say, “Our Lord, grant us in this world righteousness, and in the Hereafter righteousness, and spare us the agony of Hell.”
arabic_uthmani: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Each of these groups will receive the share they have earned for themselves. GOD is most efficient in reckoning.
arabic_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall commemorate GOD for a number of days (in Mena); whoever hastens to do this in two days commits no sin, and whoever stays longer commits no sin, so long as righteousness is maintained. You shall observe GOD, and know that before Him you will be gathered.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ مَّعْدُودَٰتٍ ۚ فَمَن تَعَجَّلَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَآ إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ وَمَن تَأَخَّرَ فَلَآ إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ لِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Among the people, one may impress you with his pious utterances in this world, as he calls upon GOD to witness his innermost thoughts, while he is a most ardent opponent.
arabic_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُعْجِبُكَ قَوْلُهُۥ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا فِى قَلْبِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَلَدُّ ٱلْخِصَامِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: As soon as he leaves, he roams the earth corruptingly, destroying properties and lives. GOD does not love corruption.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا تَوَلَّىٰ سَعَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيُفْسِدَ فِيهَا وَيُهْلِكَ ٱلْحَرْثَ وَٱلنَّسْلَ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْفَسَادَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When he is told, “Observe GOD,” he becomes arrogantly indignant. Therefore, his only destiny is Hell; what a miserable abode.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلْعِزَّةُ بِٱلْإِثْمِ ۚ فَحَسْبُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Then there is the one who dedicate his life to serve GOD; GOD is compassionate towards the worshipers.
arabic_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشْرِى نَفْسَهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, enter into total submission, and do not follow the steps of Satan; he is your most ardent enemy.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ فِى ٱلسِّلْمِ كَآفَّةً وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you backslide, despite these clear revelations, then know that GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: فَإِن زَلَلْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْكُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O people, worship your Lord—the One who created you and those before you—that you may be saved.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Are they waiting until GOD comes to them in dense clouds, together with the angels? The whole matter will then be terminated, and to GOD everything will be returned.*
arabic_uthmani: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ظُلَلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْغَمَامِ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Ask the Children of Israel how many profound miracles have we shown them! For those who disregard GOD’s blessings that have been manifested to them, GOD is most strict in retribution.
arabic_uthmani: سَلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ كَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۭ بَيِّنَةٍ ۗ وَمَن يُبَدِّلْ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Adorned for the disbelievers is this worldly life, and they mock those who believed. However, the righteous will be far above them on the Day of Resurrection. GOD endows whomever He wills, without limits.
arabic_uthmani: زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَسْخَرُونَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۘ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The people used to be one community, until GOD sent the prophets, as bearers of good news, as well as warners, and He revealed through them the scripture, truthfully, to judge among the people in their disputes. But those who received the scripture rejected any new scripture, despite clear proofs, due to jealousy on their part. GOD guides those who believe to the truth that is disputed by others, as He wills. GOD guides whom ever He wills in a straight path.*
arabic_uthmani: كَانَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً فَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ وَأَنزَلَ مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فِيمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ فِيهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ فَهَدَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do you expect to enter Paradise without being tested like those before you? They were afflicted with hardship and adversity, and were shaken up until the messenger and those who believed with him said, “Where is GOD’s victory?” GOD’s victory is always near.
arabic_uthmani: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِكُم مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِكُم ۖ مَّسَّتْهُمُ ٱلْبَأْسَآءُ وَٱلضَّرَّآءُ وَزُلْزِلُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ مَتَىٰ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ نَصْرَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They ask you about charity; say, “Whatever charity you give shall go to the parents, the relatives, the orphans, the poor, and the traveling alien.” Any good you do, GOD is fully aware thereof.
arabic_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَ ۖ قُلْ مَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ فَلِلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ وَٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ وَٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۗ وَمَا تَفْعَلُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Fighting may be forced upon you, though you do not like it. But you may dislike something which is actually good for you, and you may like something which is actually bad for you. GOD knows while you do not know.
arabic_uthmani: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تَكْرَهُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تُحِبُّوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They ask you about fighting during the Sacred Months: say, “Fighting therein is a sacrilege. But repelling from the path of GOD, disbelieving in Him and in the sanctity of the Sacred Mosque, and evicting its people therefrom are greater sacrileges in the sight of GOD. For oppression is worse than murder.” They will continue to fight you in order to revert you from your religion, if they can. Those among you who revert from their religion, and die as disbelievers, have wasted all their works in this life and in the Hereafter. These will be dwellers of Hell, wherein they abide forever.
arabic_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلْحَرَامِ قِتَالٍ فِيهِ ۖ قُلْ قِتَالٌ فِيهِ كَبِيرٌ ۖ وَصَدٌّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَكُفْرٌۢ بِهِۦ وَٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَإِخْرَاجُ أَهْلِهِۦ مِنْهُ أَكْبَرُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱلْفِتْنَةُ أَكْبَرُ مِنَ ٱلْقَتْلِ ۗ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَكُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَرُدُّوكُمْ عَن دِينِكُمْ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ ۚ وَمَن يَرْتَدِدْ مِنكُمْ عَن دِينِهِۦ فَيَمُتْ وَهُوَ كَافِرٌ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who believe, and those who immigrate and strive in the cause of GOD, have deserved GOD’s mercy. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They ask you about intoxicants and gambling:* say, “In them there is gross sin, and some benefits for the people. But their sin far outweighs their benefit.” And they ask you what to spend in charity: say, “The excess.” GOD thus clarifies the revelations for you, that you may reflect—
arabic_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْخَمْرِ وَٱلْمَيْسِرِ ۖ قُلْ فِيهِمَآ إِثْمٌ كَبِيرٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَإِثْمُهُمَآ أَكْبَرُ مِن نَّفْعِهِمَا ۗ وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَ قُلِ ٱلْعَفْوَ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He is the One who made the earth habitable for you, and the sky a structure. He sends down water from the sky to produce all kinds of fruits for your sustenance. You shall not set up idols to rival GOD, now that you know.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِرَٰشًا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: on this life and the Hereafter. And they ask you about the orphans: say, “Righteous upbringing is the best you can do for them. If you mix their property with yours, then treat them as members of your family.” GOD knows the righteous from the wicked. Had GOD willed, He could have imposed harsher rules upon you. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۗ وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ ۖ قُلْ إِصْلَاحٌ لَّهُمْ خَيْرٌ ۖ وَإِن تُخَالِطُوهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْمُفْسِدَ مِنَ ٱلْمُصْلِحِ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَعْنَتَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do not marry idolatress women unless they believe; a believing woman is better than an idolatress, even if you like her. And do not give your daughters in marriage to idolaters, unless they believe. A believer is better than the idolater, even if you like him. Those people invite to Hell, while GOD invites to Paradise and forgiveness by His leave. He clarifies His revelations for the people, that they may remember.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ حَتَّىٰ يُؤْمِنَّ ۚ وَلَأَمَةٌ مُّؤْمِنَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّن مُّشْرِكَةٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تُنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ حَتَّىٰ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ وَلَعَبْدٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ خَيْرٌ مِّن مُّشْرِكٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكُمْ ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۖ وَيُبَيِّنُ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They ask you about menstruation: say, “It is harmful. Therefore, avoid sexual intercourse with the women during menstruation, and do not approach them until they are over it. Once they are over it, you may have intercourse with them in the manner designed by by GOD. GOD loves the repenters, and He loves those who are clean.”
arabic_uthmani: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْمَحِيضِ ۖ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَٱعْتَزِلُوا۟ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فِى ٱلْمَحِيضِ ۖ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَطْهُرْنَ ۖ فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلتَّوَّٰبِينَ وَيُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Your women are the bearers of your seed. Thus, you may enjoy them however you wish, so long as you maintain righteousness. You shall observe GOD, and know that you will ultimately meet Him. Give good news to the believers.
arabic_uthmani: نِسَآؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَّكُمْ فَأْتُوا۟ حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّىٰ شِئْتُمْ ۖ وَقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُم مُّلَـٰقُوهُ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do not subject GOD’s name to your casual swearing, seeking a facade of righteousness and virtue, or put on a pious appearance among the people. GOD is Hearer, Knower.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عُرْضَةً لِّأَيْمَـٰنِكُمْ أَن تَبَرُّوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ وَتُصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD does not hold you responsible for the mere utterance of oaths; He holds you responsible for your actual intentions. GOD is Forgiver, Clement.
arabic_uthmani: لَّا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِٱللَّغْوِ فِىٓ أَيْمَـٰنِكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا كَسَبَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who intend to estrange their wives shall wait four months (for cooling off); if they reconcile, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: لِّلَّذِينَ يُؤْلُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ تَرَبُّصُ أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ ۖ فَإِن فَآءُو فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If they go through with the divorce, then GOD is Hearer, Knower.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِنْ عَزَمُوا۟ ٱلطَّلَـٰقَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The divorced women shall wait three menstruations (before marrying another man). It is not lawful for them to conceal what GOD has created in their wombs, il they believe in GOD and the Last Day. (In case of pregnancy,) the husband’s wishes shall supersede the wife’s wishes if he wants to remarry her. The women have rights, as well as obligations, equitably. Thus, the man's wishes prevail (in case of pregnancy). GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلْمُطَلَّقَـٰتُ يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِأَنفُسِهِنَّ ثَلَـٰثَةَ قُرُوٓءٍ ۚ وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَهُنَّ أَن يَكْتُمْنَ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ فِىٓ أَرْحَامِهِنَّ إِن كُنَّ يُؤْمِنَّ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۚ وَبُعُولَتُهُنَّ أَحَقُّ بِرَدِّهِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ إِنْ أَرَادُوٓا۟ إِصْلَـٰحًا ۚ وَلَهُنَّ مِثْلُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِنَّ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۚ وَلِلرِّجَالِ عَلَيْهِنَّ دَرَجَةٌ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Divorce may be retracted twice. The divorced woman shall be allowed to live in the same home amicably, or leave it amicably.* It is not lawful to take back anything you had given her, unless the couple fears that they may transgress GOD’s law. If there is fear that they may transgress GOD’s law, they commit no sin if the wife willingly gives anything back. These are GOD’s laws; do not transgress them. Those who transgress GOD’s laws are the unjust.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلطَّلَـٰقُ مَرَّتَانِ ۖ فَإِمْسَاكٌۢ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌۢ بِإِحْسَـٰنٍ ۗ وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَن تَأْخُذُوا۟ مِمَّآ ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّآ أَن يَخَافَآ أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا فِيمَا ٱفْتَدَتْ بِهِۦ ۗ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَعْتَدُوهَا ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you have any doubt regarding what we revealed to our servant,* then produce one sura like these, and ask the idols you had set up besides GOD (to do the same), if you are truthful.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا فَأْتُوا۟ بِسُورَةٍ مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ وَٱدْعُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If he divorces her for the third time, it is not lawful for him to remarry her, unless she marries another man, and he divorces her. The first husband can then remarry her, so long as they observe GOD’s laws. These are GOD’s laws; He explains them for people who know.
arabic_uthmani: فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا تَحِلُّ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدُ حَتَّىٰ تَنكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُۥ ۗ فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَآ أَن يَتَرَاجَعَآ إِن ظَنَّآ أَن يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ يُبَيِّنُهَا لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you divorce the women, once they fulfill their interim (three menstruations), you shall allow them to live in the same home amicably, or let them leave amicably. Do not force them to stay, as a revenge. Anyone who does this wrongs his own soul. Do not take GOD’s revelations lightly, and remember GOD’s blessings upon you, and what He sent down to you of scripture and wisdom to teach you. You shall observe GOD, and know that GOD is fully aware of all things.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ سَرِّحُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ ۚ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوهُنَّ ضِرَارًا لِّتَعْتَدُوا۟ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُۥ ۚ وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًا ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْحِكْمَةِ يَعِظُكُم بِهِۦ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you divorce the women, once they fulfill their interim, do not prevent them from remarrying their husbands, if they reconcile amicably. This will be heeded by those among you who believe in GOD and the Last Day. This is purer for you, and more righteous. GOD knows, while you do not know.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَلَا تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ أَن يَنكِحْنَ أَزْوَٰجَهُنَّ إِذَا تَرَٰضَوْا۟ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ مِنكُمْ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۗ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Divorced mothers shall nurse their infants two full years, if the father so wishes. The father shall provide the mother’s food and clothing, equitably. No one shall be burdened beyond capacity. No mother shall be harmed on account of her infant, nor shall the father be harmed on account of his infant. If the father dies, his inheritor shall assume these responsibilities. If the parents mutually agree to part, after due consultation, they commit no sin by doing so. You commit no sin by hiring nursing mothers, so long as you pay them equitably. You shall observe GOD, and know that GOD is Seer of everything you do.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلْوَٰلِدَٰتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَـٰدَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ ۖ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يُتِمَّ ٱلرَّضَاعَةَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلْمَوْلُودِ لَهُۥ رِزْقُهُنَّ وَكِسْوَتُهُنَّ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۚ لَا تُكَلَّفُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَا تُضَآرَّ وَٰلِدَةٌۢ بِوَلَدِهَا وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ لَّهُۥ بِوَلَدِهِۦ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلْوَارِثِ مِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ ۗ فَإِنْ أَرَادَا فِصَالًا عَن تَرَاضٍ مِّنْهُمَا وَتَشَاوُرٍ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا ۗ وَإِنْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن تَسْتَرْضِعُوٓا۟ أَوْلَـٰدَكُمْ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا سَلَّمْتُم مَّآ ءَاتَيْتُم بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who die and leave wives, their widows shall wait four months and ten days (before remarriage). Once they fulfill their interim, you commit no sin by letting them do whatever they wish, equitably. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَٰجًا يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِأَنفُسِهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ۖ فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا فَعَلْنَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِنَّ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You commit no sin if you declare your engagement to the women, or keep it secret. GOD knows that you will think about them. But do not meet them secretly, unless you have something righteous to discuss. Do not consummate the marriage until the interim is fulfilled. You should know that GOD knows your innermost thoughts, so observe Him, and know that GOD is Forgiver, Clement.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا عَرَّضْتُم بِهِۦ مِنْ خِطْبَةِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ أَوْ أَكْنَنتُمْ فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ سَتَذْكُرُونَهُنَّ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُوَاعِدُوهُنَّ سِرًّا إِلَّآ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا ۚ وَلَا تَعْزِمُوا۟ عُقْدَةَ ٱلنِّكَاحِ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ أَجَلَهُۥ ۚ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُ ۚ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You commit no error if you divorce the women before touching them, or before setting the dowry for them. In that case, you shall compensate them—the rich as he can afford and the poor as he can afford—an equitable compensation. This is a duty upon the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِن طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ مَا لَمْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ أَوْ تَفْرِضُوا۟ لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً ۚ وَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ عَلَى ٱلْمُوسِعِ قَدَرُهُۥ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُقْتِرِ قَدَرُهُۥ مَتَـٰعًۢا بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۖ حَقًّا عَلَى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you divorce them before touching them, but after you had set the dowry for them, the compensation shall be half the dowry, unless they voluntarily forfeit their right, or the responsible party chooses to forfeit the whole dowry. To forfeit is closer to righteousness. Do not abandon the amicable relations among you. GOD is Seer of everything you do.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِن طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ وَقَدْ فَرَضْتُمْ لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً فَنِصْفُ مَا فَرَضْتُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يَعْفُونَ أَوْ يَعْفُوَا۟ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ عُقْدَةُ ٱلنِّكَاحِ ۚ وَأَن تَعْفُوٓا۟ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَنسَوُا۟ ٱلْفَضْلَ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall observe the contact prayers (Salat), especially the middle prayer (the Afternoon Prayer), and devote your worship totally to GOD alone.
arabic_uthmani: حَـٰفِظُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلصَّلَوَٰتِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ٱلْوُسْطَىٰ وَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ قَـٰنِتِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Under unusual circumstances, you may pray while walking or riding. Once it is safe, you shall commemorate GOD as He taught you what you never knew.
arabic_uthmani: فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ فَرِجَالًا أَوْ رُكْبَانًا ۖ فَإِذَآ أَمِنتُمْ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَمَا عَلَّمَكُم مَّا لَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you cannot do this—and you can never do this—then beware of the Hellfire, whose fuel is people and rocks; it awaits the disbelievers.
arabic_uthmani: فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ وَلَن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ ۖ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: For those who die and leave wives, a will shall provide their wives with support for one year, provided they stay within the same household. If they leave, you commit no sin by letting them do whatever they wish, so long as righteousness is observed. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَٰجًا وَصِيَّةً لِّأَزْوَٰجِهِم مَّتَـٰعًا إِلَى ٱلْحَوْلِ غَيْرَ إِخْرَاجٍ ۚ فَإِنْ خَرَجْنَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى مَا فَعَلْنَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِنَّ مِن مَّعْرُوفٍ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The divorcees also shall be provided for, equitably. This is a duty upon the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: وَلِلْمُطَلَّقَـٰتِ مَتَـٰعٌۢ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۖ حَقًّا عَلَى ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD thus explains His revelations for you, that you may understand.
arabic_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Have you noted those who fled their homes, though they were in the thousands, fearing death? GOD said to them, “Die,” then revived them. GOD showers His blessings upon the people, but most people are not appreciative.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِمْ وَهُمْ أُلُوفٌ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ فَقَالَ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مُوتُوا۟ ثُمَّ أَحْيَـٰهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall fight in the cause of GOD, and know that GOD is Hearer, Knower.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَـٰتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Would you not lend GOD a good loan, to have it repaid to you multiplied manifold? GOD is the One who provides and withholds, and to Him you will be returned.
arabic_uthmani: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَـٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥٓ أَضْعَافًا كَثِيرَةً ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَقْبِضُ وَيَبْصُۜطُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Have you noted the leaders among the Children of Israel after Moses? They said to their prophet, “If you appoint a king to lead us, we will fight in the cause of GOD.” He said, “Is it your intention that, if fighting is imposed upon you, you will not fight?” They said, “Why should we not fight in the cause of GOD, when we were evicted from our homes, together with our children?” Yet, when fighting was decreed for them, they turned away, except a few. GOD is fully aware of the transgressors.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ مِنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لِنَبِىٍّ لَّهُمُ ٱبْعَثْ لَنَا مَلِكًا نُّقَـٰتِلْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ هَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ أَلَّا تُقَـٰتِلُوا۟ ۖ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نُقَـٰتِلَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ أُخْرِجْنَا مِن دِيَـٰرِنَا وَأَبْنَآئِنَا ۖ فَلَمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ تَوَلَّوْا۟ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنْهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Their prophet said to them, “GOD has appointed Taloot (Saul) to be your king.” They said, “How can he be our king when we are more worthy of kingship than he is? He is not even rich!” He said, “GOD has chosen him over you, and has blessed him with an abundance in knowledge and in body.” GOD grants His kingship to whomever He wills. GOD is Bounteous, Omniscient.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ بَعَثَ لَكُمْ طَالُوتَ مَلِكًا ۚ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ عَلَيْنَا وَنَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِٱلْمُلْكِ مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يُؤْتَ سَعَةً مِّنَ ٱلْمَالِ ۚ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَزَادَهُۥ بَسْطَةً فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ وَٱلْجِسْمِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يُؤْتِى مُلْكَهُۥ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Their prophet said to them, “The sign of his kingship is that the Ark of the Covenant will be restored to you, bringing assurance from your Lord, and relics left by the people of Moses and Aaron. It will be carried to you by the angels. This should be a convincing sign for you, if you are really believers.”
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِنَّ ءَايَةَ مُلْكِهِۦٓ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلتَّابُوتُ فِيهِ سَكِينَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَبَقِيَّةٌ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ ءَالُ مُوسَىٰ وَءَالُ هَـٰرُونَ تَحْمِلُهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When Saul took command of the troops, he said, “GOD is putting you to the test by means of a stream. Anyone who drinks from it, does not belong with me, unless it is to taste a single sip.” They drank from it, except a few. When he crossed it, together with those who believed, they said, “Now we lack the strength to face Goliath and his troops.” Those who believed in meeting GOD said, “Many a small army defeated a large army by GOD’s leave. GOD is with those who steadfastly persevere.”
arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And give good news to those who believe and lead a righteous life that they have deserved gardens with flowing streams. When provided with a provision of fruits therein, they say, “This is what was provided for us previously.” Thus, they are given allegorical descriptions. They will have pure spouses therein, and they abide therein forever.
arabic_uthmani: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٍ رِّزْقًا ۙ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى رُزِقْنَا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَأُتُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُتَشَـٰبِهًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَآ أَزْوَٰجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ ۖ وَهُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When they faced Goliath and his troops, they prayed, “Our Lord, grant us steadfastness, strengthen our foothold, and grant us victory over the disbelieving people.” The Believers Always Victorious Victory Comes Only From God
arabic_uthmani: وَلَمَّا بَرَزُوا۟ لِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They defeated them by GOD’s leave, and David killed Goliath. And GOD granted him kingship and wisdom, and taught him as He willed. If it were not for GOD’s support of some people against others, there would be chaos on earth. GOD’s grace encompasses all creation.
arabic_uthmani: فَهَزَمُوهُم بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَتَلَ دَاوُۥدُ جَالُوتَ وَءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُلْكَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَعَلَّمَهُۥ مِمَّا يَشَآءُ ۗ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لَّفَسَدَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: These are GOD’s revelations. We recite them through you, truthfully, for you are one of the messengers.*
arabic_uthmani: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have blessed some messengers more than others. For example, GOD spoke to one of them. And we raised some of them to higher ranks. And we gave Jesus the son of Mary profound miracles, and supported him with the Holy Spirit. Had GOD willed, their followers would not have fought with each other, despite the clear proofs that came to them. Instead, they disputed among themselves; some of them believed, and some disbelieved. Had GOD willed, they would not have fought. But GOD does whatever He wills.
arabic_uthmani: تِلْكَ ٱلرُّسُلُ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۘ مِّنْهُم مَّن كَلَّمَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَهُمْ دَرَجَـٰتٍ ۚ وَءَاتَيْنَا عِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَأَيَّدْنَـٰهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ ۗ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا ٱقْتَتَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ وَلَـٰكِنِ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ ءَامَنَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن كَفَرَ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, give from our provisions to you, before a day comes where there is no trade, no nepotism, and no intercession. The disbelievers are the unjust. God
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا بَيْعٌ فِيهِ وَلَا خُلَّةٌ وَلَا شَفَـٰعَةٌ ۗ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD: there is no other god besides Him, the Living, the Eternal. Never a moment of unawareness or slumber overtakes Him. To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on the earth. Who could intercede with Him, except in accordance with His will? He knows their past, and their future. No one attains any knowledge, except as He wills. His dominion encompasses the heavens and the earth, and ruling them never burdens Him. He is the Most High, the Great.
arabic_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: There shall be no compulsion in religion: the right way is now distinguished from the wrong way. Thus, anyone who denounces the devil and believes in GOD, has gotten hold of the strongest bond that never breaks. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
arabic_uthmani: لَآ إِكْرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشْدُ مِنَ ٱلْغَىِّ ۚ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلطَّـٰغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD the Lord of those who believe; He leads them out of darkness into the light. As for those who disbelieve, their lords are the devils; they lead them out of the light into darkness. They have deserved Hell, wherein they abide forever.
arabic_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُمُ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتُ يُخْرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ ٱلنُّورِ إِلَى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Have you noted the one who argued with Abraham about his Lord, though GOD had given him kingship? Abraham said, “My Lord grants life and death.” He said, “I grant life and death.” Abraham said, “GOD brings the sun from the east, can you bring it from the west?” The disbeliever was stumped. GOD does not guide the wicked.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِى حَآجَّ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ فِى رَبِّهِۦٓ أَنْ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُلْكَ إِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمُ رَبِّىَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ قَالَ أَنَا۠ أُحْىِۦ وَأُمِيتُ ۖ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْتِى بِٱلشَّمْسِ مِنَ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ فَأْتِ بِهَا مِنَ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ فَبُهِتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Or the one who passed by a ghost town and wondered, “How can GOD revive this, after it had died?” GOD then put him to death for one hundred years, then resurrected him. He said, “How long have you been here?” He said, “I have been here one day, or part of the day.” He said, “You have been here a hundred years. Yet, look at your food and drink; they did not spoil. And look at your donkey—we thus render you a lesson* for the people. Note how we construct the bones, then cover them with flesh.” When he realized what had happened, he said, “Now I know that GOD is Omnipotent.”
arabic_uthmani: أَوْ كَٱلَّذِى مَرَّ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا قَالَ أَنَّىٰ يُحْىِۦ هَـٰذِهِ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۖ فَأَمَاتَهُ ٱللَّهُ مِا۟ئَةَ عَامٍ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتَ ۖ قَالَ لَبِثْتُ يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ ۖ قَالَ بَل لَّبِثْتَ مِا۟ئَةَ عَامٍ فَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِكَ وَشَرَابِكَ لَمْ يَتَسَنَّهْ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰ حِمَارِكَ وَلِنَجْعَلَكَ ءَايَةً لِّلنَّاسِ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَى ٱلْعِظَامِ كَيْفَ نُنشِزُهَا ثُمَّ نَكْسُوهَا لَحْمًا ۚ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُۥ قَالَ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD does not shy away from citing any kind of allegory,* from the tiny mosquito and higher. Those who believed know that this is the truth from their Lord, while those who disbelieved say, “What did GOD mean by such an allegory?” He guides many thereby, and misleads many thereby; but He never misleads thereby except the wicked
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْىِۦٓ أَن يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا بَعُوضَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۘ يُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِيرًا وَيَهْدِى بِهِۦ كَثِيرًا ۚ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Abraham said, “My Lord, show me how You revive the dead.” He said, “Do you not believe?” He said, “Yes indeed, but I wish to reassure my heart.” He said, “Take four birds, study their marks, place a piece of each bird on top of a hill, then call them to you; they will come to you in a hurry. And know that GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.”
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمُ رَبِّ أَرِنِى كَيْفَ تُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ قَالَ أَوَلَمْ تُؤْمِن ۖ قَالَ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِى ۖ قَالَ فَخُذْ أَرْبَعَةً مِّنَ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَصُرْهُنَّ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ جَبَلٍ مِّنْهُنَّ جُزْءًا ثُمَّ ٱدْعُهُنَّ يَأْتِينَكَ سَعْيًا ۚ وَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The example of those who spend their money in the cause of GOD is that of a grain that produces seven spikes, with a hundred grains in each spike. And GOD multiplies this manifold for whomever He wills. GOD is Bounteous, Knower.
arabic_uthmani: مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنۢبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِى كُلِّ سُنۢبُلَةٍ مِّا۟ئَةُ حَبَّةٍ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُضَـٰعِفُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who give their money in the cause of GOD, then do not follow their charity with insult or reproach, will receive their recompense from their Lord; they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ لَا يُتْبِعُونَ مَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ مَنًّا وَلَآ أَذًى ۙ لَّهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Kind words and compassion are better than a charity that is followed by insult. GOD is Rich, Clement.
arabic_uthmani: قَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّن صَدَقَةٍ يَتْبَعُهَآ أَذًى ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, do not nullify your charities by inflicting insult and harm. As for those who spend their money to show off, while disbelieving in GOD and the Last Day, their example is like a rock that is covered with a thin layer of soil; when heavy rain falls, the soil washes off, leaving the rock barren and useless. Thus, they gain nothing from their efforts. GOD does not guide the disbelieving people.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُبْطِلُوا۟ صَدَقَـٰتِكُم بِٱلْمَنِّ وَٱلْأَذَىٰ كَٱلَّذِى يُنفِقُ مَالَهُۥ رِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۖ فَمَثَلُهُۥ كَمَثَلِ صَفْوَانٍ عَلَيْهِ تُرَابٌ فَأَصَابَهُۥ وَابِلٌ فَتَرَكَهُۥ صَلْدًا ۖ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ مِّمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The example of those who give their money seeking GOD’s pleasure, and in response to their own convictions, is that of a high fertile soil; when heavy rain falls, it produces twice the yield. If heavy rain is not available, a drizzle will suffice. GOD is Seer of everything you do.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِ ٱللَّهِ وَتَثْبِيتًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ كَمَثَلِ جَنَّةٍۭ بِرَبْوَةٍ أَصَابَهَا وَابِلٌ فَـَٔاتَتْ أُكُلَهَا ضِعْفَيْنِ فَإِن لَّمْ يُصِبْهَا وَابِلٌ فَطَلٌّ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Does any of you wish to own a garden of palm trees and grapes, with flowing streams, and generous crops, then, just as he grows older, with children who are still dependent on him, a holocaust strikes and burns up his garden? GOD thus clarifies the revelations for you, that you may reflect.
arabic_uthmani: أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَأَصَابَهُ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَلَهُۥ ذُرِّيَّةٌ ضُعَفَآءُ فَأَصَابَهَآ إِعْصَارٌ فِيهِ نَارٌ فَٱحْتَرَقَتْ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, you shall give to charity from the good things you earn, and from the products we provide for you from the earth. Do not pick out that which is bad to give away, when you yourselves would not accept it unless your eyes were closed. You should know that GOD is Rich, Praiseworthy.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا كَسَبْتُمْ وَمِمَّآ أَخْرَجْنَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَلَا تَيَمَّمُوا۟ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنْهُ تُنفِقُونَ وَلَسْتُم بِـَٔاخِذِيهِ إِلَّآ أَن تُغْمِضُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The devil promises you poverty, and commands you to commit evil, while GOD promises you forgiveness from Him, and grace. GOD is Bounteous, Omniscient.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱلْفَقْرَ وَيَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَعِدُكُم مَّغْفِرَةً مِّنْهُ وَفَضْلًا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He bestows wisdom upon whomever He chooses, and whoever attains wisdom, has attained a great bounty. Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.
arabic_uthmani: يُؤْتِى ٱلْحِكْمَةَ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْتَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدْ أُوتِىَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: who violate GOD covenant after pledging to uphold it, sever what GOD commanded to be joined, and commit evil. These are the losers. Two Deaths and Two Lives*
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مِيثَـٰقِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Any charity you give, or a charitable pledge you fulfill, GOD is fully aware thereof. As for the wicked, they have no supporters.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن نَّفَقَةٍ أَوْ نَذَرْتُم مِّن نَّذْرٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُهُۥ ۗ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you declare your charities, they are still good. But if you keep them anonymous, and give them to the poor, it is better for you, and remits more of your sins. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.
arabic_uthmani: إِن تُبْدُوا۟ ٱلصَّدَقَـٰتِ فَنِعِمَّا هِىَ ۖ وَإِن تُخْفُوهَا وَتُؤْتُوهَا ٱلْفُقَرَآءَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۚ وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنكُم مِّن سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You are not responsible for guiding them. GOD is the only one who guides; He guides whomever He wills. Any charity you give is for your own good. Any charity you give shall be only for the sake of GOD. Any charity you give will be repaid to you, without the least injustice.
arabic_uthmani: لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكَ هُدَىٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلِأَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُونَ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Charity shall go to the poor who are suffering in the cause of GOD, and cannot emigrate. The unaware may think that they are rich, due to their dignified appearance. You can recognize them by their marks; they never engage in begging from the people. Whatever charity you give, GOD is fully aware thereof.
arabic_uthmani: لِلْفُقَرَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُحْصِرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ضَرْبًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَحْسَبُهُمُ ٱلْجَاهِلُ أَغْنِيَآءَ مِنَ ٱلتَّعَفُّفِ تَعْرِفُهُم بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔلُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ إِلْحَافًا ۗ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who give to charity night and day, secretly and publicly, receive their recompense from their Lord; they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
