arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, do not follow the steps of Satan, for anyone who follows the steps of Satan will be led to evil and vice. If it were not for GOD’s grace towards you, and His mercy, none of you would have been purified. But GOD purifies whomever He wills. GOD is Hearer, Knower.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّى مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Let those among you who are blessed with resources and wealth give to their relatives, the poor, and to those who have immigrated for the sake of GOD. They shall forgive and forget; do you not love to attain GOD’s forgiveness? GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Surely, those who falsely accuse married women who are pious believers have incurred condemnation in this life and in the Hereafter; they have incurred a horrendous retribution.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَـٰتِ ٱلْغَـٰفِلَـٰتِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ لُعِنُوا۟ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The day will come when their own tongues, hands, and feet will bear witness to everything they had done.
arabic_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: On that day, GOD will pay them fully for their works, and they will find out that GOD is the Truth.
arabic_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ يُوَفِّيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبِينُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The bad women for the bad men, and the bad men for the bad women, and the good women for the good men, and the good men for the good women. The latter are innocent of such accusations (as the Big Lie). They have attained forgiveness and a generous reward.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلْخَبِيثَـٰتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَٱلْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَـٰتِ ۖ وَٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَٱلطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ ۖ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, do not enter homes other than yours without permission from their inhabitants, and without greeting them. This is better for you, that you may take heed.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَأْنِسُوا۟ وَتُسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you find no one in them, then do not enter them until you obtain permission. If you are told, “Go back,” you must go back, for it is purer for you. GOD is fully aware of everything you do.
arabic_uthmani: فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا۟ فِيهَآ أَحَدًا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ ۖ هُوَ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You commit no error by entering uninhabited homes wherein there is something that belongs to you. GOD knows everything you reveal, as well as everything you conceal.
arabic_uthmani: لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ فِيهَا مَتَـٰعٌ لَّكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The adulterer will end up marrying an adulteress or an idol worshiper, and the adulteress will end up marrying an adulterer or an idol worshiper. This is prohibited for the believers.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Tell the believing men that they shall subdue their eyes (and not stare at the women), and to maintain their chastity. This is purer for them. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything they do.
arabic_uthmani: قُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّوا۟ مِنْ أَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوا۟ فُرُوجَهُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَزْكَىٰ لَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And tell the believing women to subdue their eyes, and maintain their chastity. They shall not reveal any parts of their bodies, except that which is necessary—they shall cover their chests. They shall not relax this code in the presence of other than their husbands, their fathers, the fathers of their husbands, their sons, the sons of their husbands their brothers, the sons of their brothers, the sons of their sisters, other women, the servants or employees who have no sexual drive, or the children who have not reached puberty. They shall not strike their feet when they walk in order to shake and reveal certain details of their bodies. All of you shall repent to GOD, O you believers, that you may succeed.*
arabic_uthmani: وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَـٰرِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّ ۖ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُنَّ أَوِ ٱلتَّـٰبِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُو۟لِى ٱلْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ أَوِ ٱلطِّفْلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَوْرَٰتِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۖ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّ ۚ وَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall encourage those of you who are single to get married. They may even marry the righteous among your male and female servants; if they are poor, GOD will enrich them from His grace. GOD is Bounteous, Knower.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْأَيَـٰمَىٰ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَآئِكُمْ ۚ إِن يَكُونُوا۟ فُقَرَآءَ يُغْنِهِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who cannot afford to get married shall maintain morality until GOD provides for them from His grace. Those among your slaves who wish to be freed in order to marry, you shall grant them their wish, once you realize that they are honest. And give to them from GOD’s money that He has bestowed upon you. You shall not force your girls to commit prostitution, seeking the materials of this world, if they wish to be chaste. If anyone forces them, then GOD, seeing that they are forced, is Forgiver, Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّىٰ يُغْنِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبْتَغُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا ۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مِّن مَّالِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۚ وَلَا تُكْرِهُوا۟ فَتَيَـٰتِكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْبِغَآءِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًا لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ عَرَضَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَمَن يُكْرِههُّنَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِكْرَٰهِهِنَّ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have revealed to you clarifying revelations, and examples from the past generations, and an enlightenment for the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتٍ مُّبَيِّنَـٰتٍ وَمَثَلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD is the light of the heavens and the earth. The allegory of His light is that of a concave mirror behind a lamp that is placed inside a glass container. The glass container is like a bright, pearl-like star. The fuel thereof is supplied from a blessed oil-producing tree, that is so vast it encompasses both east and west. Its oil is almost self-radiating; needs no fire to ignite it. Light upon light. GOD guides to His light whomever He wills. GOD thus cites the parables for the people. GOD is fully aware of all things.
arabic_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِۦ كَمِشْكَوٰةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ ۖ ٱلْمِصْبَاحُ فِى زُجَاجَةٍ ۖ ٱلزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّىٌّ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِىٓءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ ۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ ۗ يَهْدِى ٱللَّهُ لِنُورِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ لِلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: (Such guidance is found) in houses which are exalted by GOD, for His name is commemorated therein. Glorifying Him therein, day and night—
arabic_uthmani: فِى بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ ٱللَّهُ أَن تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسْمُهُۥ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْءَاصَالِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: are people who are not distracted by business or trade from commemorating GOD, and observing the contact prayers {Salat), and giving the obligatory charity (Zakat). They fear the day when the hearts and eyes will be horrified.
arabic_uthmani: رِجَالٌ لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَـٰرَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءِ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۙ يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD will surely reward them for their good works, and shower them with His grace. GOD provides for whomever He wills without limits.
arabic_uthmani: لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: As for those who disbelieve, their works are like a mirage in the desert. A thirsty person would think that it is water, until he reaches it and finds that it is nothing. Instead, he finds GOD there, calling him to account. GOD is the most efficient reckoner.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ كَسَرَابٍۭ بِقِيعَةٍ يَحْسَبُهُ ٱلظَّمْـَٔانُ مَآءً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَهُۥ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْـًٔا وَوَجَدَ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ فَوَفَّىٰهُ حِسَابَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who accuse married women of adultery, then fail to produce four witnesses, you shall whip them eighty lashes, and do not accept any testimony from them. These are the wicked ones.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَـٰنِينَ جَلْدَةً وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَهَـٰدَةً أَبَدًا ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Another allegory is that of being in total darkness in the midst of a violent ocean, with waves upon waves, in addition to thick fog. Darkness upon darkness—if he looked at his own hand, he could not see it.Whomever GOD deprives of light, can never have light.
arabic_uthmani: أَوْ كَظُلُمَـٰتٍ فِى بَحْرٍ لُّجِّىٍّ يَغْشَىٰهُ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ سَحَابٌ ۚ ظُلُمَـٰتٌۢ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ إِذَآ أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُۥ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَىٰهَا ۗ وَمَن لَّمْ يَجْعَلِ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ نُورًا فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن نُّورٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do you not realize that everyone in the heavens and the earth glorifies GOD, even the birds as they fly in a column? Each knows its prayer and its glorification. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلطَّيْرُ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍ ۖ كُلٌّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُۥ وَتَسْبِيحَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And to GOD belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and to GOD is the final destiny.
arabic_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do you not realize that GOD drives the clouds, gathers them together, piles them on each other, then you see water coming out of them? He sends down from the sky loads of snow to cover whomever he wills, while diverting it from whomever He wills. The brightness of the snow almost blinds the eyes.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزْجِى سَحَابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ رُكَامًا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَـٰلِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن جِبَالٍ فِيهَا مِنۢ بَرَدٍ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُۥ عَن مَّن يَشَآءُ ۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِۦ يَذْهَبُ بِٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD controls the night and day. This should be a lesson for those who have eyes.
arabic_uthmani: يُقَلِّبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And GOD created every creature from water. Some of them walk on their bellies, some walk on two legs, and some walk on four. GOD creates whatever He wills. GOD is Omnipotent.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰٓ أَرْبَعٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have sent down to you clarifying revelations, then GOD guides whomever He wills in a straight path.
arabic_uthmani: لَّقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَـٰتٍ مُّبَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They say, “We believe in GOD, and in the messenger, and we obey.” But then some of them turn away; these are not believers.
arabic_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When they are invited to GOD and His messenger to judge among them, some of them get upset.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا دُعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: However, if the judgment is in their favor, they readily accept it!
arabic_uthmani: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ يَأْتُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: However, if they repent afterwards, and reform, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Is there a disease in their hearts? Are they doubtful? Are they afraid that GOD and His messenger may treat them unfairly? In fact, it is they who are unfair.
arabic_uthmani: أَفِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ٱرْتَابُوٓا۟ أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ۚ بَلْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The only utterance of the believers, whenever invited to GOD and His messenger to judge in their affairs, is to say, “We hear, and we obey.” These are the winners.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who obey GOD and His messenger, and reverence GOD and observe Him, these are the triumphant ones.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَخْشَ ٱللَّهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They swear by GOD, solemnly, that if you commanded them to mobilize, they would mobilize. Say, “Do not swear. Obedience is an obligation. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.”
arabic_uthmani: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ لَئِنْ أَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ ۖ قُل لَّا تُقْسِمُوا۟ ۖ طَاعَةٌ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Obey GOD, and obey the messenger.” If they refuse, then he is responsible for his obligations, and you are responsible for your obligations. If you obey him, you will be guided. The sole duty of the messenger is to deliver (the message).
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا۟ ۚ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD promises those among you who believe and lead a righteous life, that He will make them sovereigns on earth, as He did for those before them, and will establish for them the religion He has chosen for them, and will substitute peace and security for them in place of fear. All this because they worship Me alone, without setting up any idols besides Me. Those who disbelieve after this are the truly wicked.
arabic_uthmani: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمَا ٱسْتَخْلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱرْتَضَىٰ لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا ۚ يَعْبُدُونَنِى لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِى شَيْـًٔا ۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and obey the messenger, that you may attain mercy.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do not think that those who disbelieve will ever get away with it. Their final abode is Hell; what a miserable destiny.
arabic_uthmani: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, permission must be requested by your servants and the children who have not attained puberty (before entering your rooms). This is to be done in three instances—before the Dawn Prayer, at noon when you change your clothes to rest, and after the Night Prayer. These are three private times for you. At other times, it is not wrong for you or them to mingle with one another. GOD thus clarifies the revelations for you. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِيَسْتَـْٔذِنكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا۟ ٱلْحُلُمَ مِنكُمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مَرَّٰتٍ ۚ مِّن قَبْلِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنۢ بَعْدِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلْعِشَآءِ ۚ ثَلَـٰثُ عَوْرَٰتٍ لَّكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحٌۢ بَعْدَهُنَّ ۚ طَوَّٰفُونَ عَلَيْكُم بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَـٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Once the children reach puberty, they must ask permission (before entering) like those who became adults before them have asked permission (before entering). GOD thus clarifies His revelations for you. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise. Modest Dress is Best
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَلَغَ ٱلْأَطْفَـٰلُ مِنكُمُ ٱلْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَـْٔذِنُوا۟ كَمَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: As for those who accuse their own spouses, without any other witnesses, then the testimony may be accepted if he swears by GOD four times that he is telling the truth.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَـٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَـٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The elderly women who do not expect to get married commit nothing wrong by relaxing their dress code, provided they do not reveal too much of their bodies. To maintain modesty is better for them. GOD is Hearer, Knower.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلْقَوَٰعِدُ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّـٰتِى لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَن يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَـٰتٍۭ بِزِينَةٍ ۖ وَأَن يَسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُنَّ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The blind is not to be blamed, the crippled is not to be blamed, nor the handicapped is to be blamed, just as you are not to be blamed for eating at your homes, or the homes of your fathers, or the homes of your mothers, or the homes of your brothers, or the homes of your sisters, or the homes of your father’s brothers, or the homes of your father’s sisters, or the homes of your mother’s brothers, or the homes of your mother’s sisters, or the homes that belong to you and you possess their keys, or the homes of your friends. You commit nothing wrong by eating together or as individuals. When you enter any home, you shall greet each other a greeting from GOD that is blessed and good. GOD thus details the revelations for you, that you may understand.
arabic_uthmani: لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَن تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ ءَابَآئِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوَٰنِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَعْمَـٰمِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّـٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوَٰلِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خَـٰلَـٰتِكُمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُۥٓ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَأْكُلُوا۟ جَمِيعًا أَوْ أَشْتَاتًا ۚ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُم بُيُوتًا فَسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةً مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَـٰرَكَةً طَيِّبَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The true believers are those who believe in GOD and His messenger, and when they are with him in a community meeting, they do not leave him without permission. Those who ask permission are the ones who do believe in GOD and His messenger. If they ask your permission, in order to tend to some of their affairs, you may grant permission to whomever you wish, and ask GOD to forgive them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَإِذَا كَانُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ جَامِعٍ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُوهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُونَكَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ فَإِذَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do not treat the messenger’s requests as you treat each others’ requests. GOD is fully aware of those among you who sneak away using flimsy excuses. Let them beware—those who disobey his orders—for a disaster may strike them, or a severe retribution.
arabic_uthmani: لَّا تَجْعَلُوا۟ دُعَآءَ ٱلرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَآءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضًا ۚ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذًا ۚ فَلْيَحْذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِۦٓ أَن تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Absolutely, to GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. He fully knows every condition you may be in. Thus, the day you are returned to Him, He will inform them of everything they had done. GOD is fully aware of all things.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ
english_transcription_note: Checked against the rendered 1989 source page.
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And the fifth oath shall be to incur GOD’s condemnation upon him, if he was lying.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلْخَـٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: She shall be considered innocent if she swears by GOD four times that he is a liar.
arabic_uthmani: وَيَدْرَؤُا۟ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَـٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And the fifth oath shall be to incur GOD’s wrath upon her if he was telling the truth.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلْخَـٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Most blessed is the One who revealed the Statute Book to His servant, so he can serve as a warner to the whole world.
arabic_uthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Most blessed is the One who, if He so wills, can give you much better than their demands—gardens with flowing streams, and many mansions.
arabic_uthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: In fact, they have disbelieved in the Hour (Day of Resurrection), and we have prepared for those who disbelieve in the Hour a flaming Hell.
arabic_uthmani: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When it sees them from afar, they hear its rage and fuming.
arabic_uthmani: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And when they are thrown into it, through a narrow place, all shackled, they will declare their remorse.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You will not declare just a single remorse, on that day; you will suffer through an infinite number of remorses.
arabic_uthmani: لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَٰحِدًا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Is this better or the eternal Paradise that is promised for the righteous as a well deserved reward, and a well deserved destiny?”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَمَصِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They get anything they wish therein, forever. This is your Lord’s irrevocable promise.
arabic_uthmani: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَـٰلِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْـُٔولًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: On the day when He summons them, together with the idols they had set up besides GOD, He will say, “Have you misled these servants of Mine, or did they go astray on their own?”
arabic_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They said, “Be You glorified, it was not right for us to set up any lords besides You. But You allowed them to enjoy, together with their parents, until they forgot the reminder and became corrupted people.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They have denied what you just said. Moreover, you can neither repel (their retribution), nor can you help them. Even you; if any of you commits evil, he will be subject to terrible retribution.
arabic_uthmani: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The One to whom belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. He never had a son, nor does He have any partners in kingship. He created everything in exact measure; He precisely designed everything.*
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقْدِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We did not send any messengers before you who did not eat food and walk in the markets. We render this a test for all of you; will you remain steadfast? Your Lord is Seer.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who do not expect to meet us said, “If only the angels could come down to us, or we could see our Lord (we would then believe)!” Indeed, they have committed gross arrogance, and produced a gross blasphemy.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The day they see the angels, it will not be good news for the guilty. They will say, “We are irreversibly confined.”
arabic_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We will look at all the works they had done, and render them utterly useless.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنثُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The dwellers of Paradise are far better on that day; they will hear better news.
arabic_uthmani: أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The heaven will break apart, into masses of clouds, and the angels will descend in multitudes.
arabic_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَـٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: All kingship on that day belongs absolutely to the Most Gracious. For the disbelievers, it will be a difficult day.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The day will come when the transgressor will bite his hands (in anguish) and say, “Oh, I wish I had followed the path of the messenger.
arabic_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “Oh, woe to me, I wish I did not take that person as a friend.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “He has led me away from the message after it came to me. Indeed, the devil lets down his human victims.”
arabic_uthmani: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ خَذُولًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Yet, they set up besides Him gods that do not create anything—they themselves are created—and possess no power to even harm or benefit themselves, nor do they possess any power to control life, or death, or resurrection.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَوٰةً وَلَا نُشُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The messenger* said, “My Lord, my people have deserted this Quran.”
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We also set up against every prophet enemies from among the guilty. Your Lord suffices as a guide, and helper.
arabic_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who disbelieved said, “Why did the Quran not come to him all at once?” We have released it to you gradually, in order to fix it in your memory. We have recited it in a specific sequence.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Whatever excuse they come up with, we provide you with the truth, and a better reply.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who are forcibly summoned to Hell are in the worst position; they are the farthest from the right path.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have given Moses the scripture, and appointed his brother Aaron to be his assistant.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We said, “Go, both of you, to the people who rejected our revelations.” Subsequently, we utterly annihilated the rejectors.
arabic_uthmani: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Similarly, when the people of Noah disbelieved the messengers, we drowned them all, and we set them up as a sign for the people. We have prepared for the transgressors a painful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةً ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Also Aad, Thamoud, the inhabitants of Al-Russ, and many generations between them.
arabic_uthmani: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: To each of these rebellious com munities we delivered sufficient examples, then we utterly annihilated them.
arabic_uthmani: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And those who disbelieved said, “This is a fabrication that he produced, with the help of other people.” They have uttered a blasphemy; a falsehood.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They have passed by the community that was showered with a miserable shower (Sodom). Did they not see it? The fact is, they never believed in resurrection.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When they saw you, they always ridiculed you: “Is this the one chosen by GOD to be a messenger?
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “He almost diverted us from our gods, if it were not that we steadfastly revered them.” They will certainly find out, when they see the retribution, who are the real strayers from the path.
arabic_uthmani: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Have you seen the one whose god is his own ego? Are you going to be his advocate?
arabic_uthmani: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do you think that most of them hear, or understand? They are just like animals; no, they are far worse.
arabic_uthmani: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Have you not seen how your Lord designed the shadow? If He willed, He could have made it fixed, and we would have designed the sun accordingly.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: But we designed it to move slowly.
arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And He is the One who designed the night to be a cover, and for you to sleep, to provide you with rest. He made the day a resurrection.
arabic_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And He is the One who sends the winds with good omens of His mercy. And we send from the sky pure water.
arabic_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: With it, we revive dead lands, and provide drink for our creations— multitudes of animals and humans.
arabic_uthmani: لِّنُحْـِۧىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And they said, “Tales from the past that he wrote down; they were dictated to him day and night.”*
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٱكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have distributed it among them in exact measure, that they may take heed. But most people insist upon disbelieving.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَـٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If we willed, we could have sent to every community a warner.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Therefore, do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with this, a great striving.
arabic_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَجَـٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And He is the One who merges the two seas; one is fresh and palatable, while the other is salty and undrinkable. And He separated them with a formidable, effective barrier (evaporation).
arabic_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And He is the One who created from water a human being, then made him reproduce through marriage and mating. Your Lord is Omnipotent.
arabic_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Yet, they still set up besides GOD idols that cannot benefit them, nor harm them. Indeed, the disbeliever is an enemy of his Lord.
arabic_uthmani: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We did not send you except as a deliverer of good news, as well as a warner.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “I do not ask you for any money. All I seek is to help you find the right path to your Lord, if this is what you choose.”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall put your trust in the One who is Alive; the One who never dies. You shall praise Him and glorify Him. He is fully Cognizant of His creatures’ sins.
arabic_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, in six days, then assumed all authority. The Most Gracious; ask about Him those who are well founded in knowledge.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “This was revealed by the One who knows the Secret* in the heavens and the earth. He is Forgiving, Most Merciful.”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِى يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When they are told, “Fall prostrate before the Most Gracious,” they say, “What is the Most Gracious? Shall we prostrate before that which is advocated by you?” Thus, it only augments their aversion.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Most blessed is the One who placed constellations in the sky, and placed therein a lamp, and a shining moon.
arabic_uthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And He is the One who designed the night and the day to alternate; a sign for those who wish to take heed, or to be appreciative. Traits o f the Righteous
arabic_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The worshipers of the Most Gracious are those who tread the earth gently, and when the ignorant speak to them, they only utter peace.
arabic_uthmani: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: In the privacy of the night, they meditate on their Lord, and fall prostrate.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَـٰمًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And they say, “Our Lord, keep the agony of Hell away from us; its retribution is horrendous.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “It is the worst abode; the worst destiny.”
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When they give, they are neither extravagant, nor stingy; they spend in moderation.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Solomon was David’s heir. He said, “O people, we have been endowed with understanding the language of the birds, and all kinds of things have been bestowed upon us. This is indeed a real blessing.”
arabic_uthmani: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Mobilized for Solomon were his soldiers of jinns, and humans, and birds; all at his service.
arabic_uthmani: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

arabic_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَـٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He smiled and laughed at her statement,* and said, “My Lord, direct me to be appreciative of the blessings that You bestowed upon me and my parents, and to do the righteous works that please You, and admit me by Your mercy to be one of Your righteous servants.”
arabic_uthmani: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “I found a woman ruling them, who is endowed with everything, and possesses a tremendous palace.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He said, “O you elders, which of you can bring me her mansion, before they arrive here as Muslims?”

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The one who possessed knowledge from the book said, “I can bring it to you in the blink of your eye.” When he saw it settled in front of him, he said, “This is a blessing from my Lord, whereby He tests me and shows whether I am appreciative or unappreciative. The appreciative is appreciative for his own good, and the unappreciative (never hurts) my Lord. He is Rich, Honorable.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّ كَرِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He said, “Remodel her mansion for her. Let us see if she will be guided, or continue with the misguided.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالَ نَكِّرُوا۟ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِىٓ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When she arrived, she was asked, “Does your mansion look like this?” She said, “It seems that this is it.” (Solomon said,) “We knew beforehand what she was going to do, and we were already Muslims.”
arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: She had been diverted by worshiping idols instead of GOD; she belonged to disbelieving people.
arabic_uthmani: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍ كَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: She was told, “Go inside the palace.” When she saw its interior, she thought it was a pool of water, and she (pulled up her dress,) exposing her legs. He said, “This interior is now paved with crystal.” She said, “My Lord, I have wronged my soul. I submit with Solomon to GOD, Lord of the universe.”
arabic_uthmani: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have sent to Thamoud their brother Saaleh, saying, “You shall worship GOD.” Whereupon, they turned into two feuding factions.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He said, “O my people, why do you hasten to commit evil instead of good works? You should implore GOD for forgiveness, that you may attain mercy.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ۖ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They said, “We consider you a bad omen for us, you and those who joined you.” He said, “Your omen rests with GOD. Indeed, you are deviant people.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ ۚ قَالَ طَـٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: There were nine gangsters in the city who committed evil, and never did anything good.
arabic_uthmani: وَكَانَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They said, “Let us swear by GOD that we kill him and his people, then tell his tribe, ‘We know nothing about their death. We are truthful.’ ”
arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ تَقَاسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They are the ones who incur the worst retribution, and in the Hereafter, they will be the worst losers.
arabic_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They plotted and schemed, but we also plotted and schemed, while they did not perceive.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Note the consequences of their plotting; we annihilated them and all their people.
arabic_uthmani: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Here are their homes utterly ruined, as a consequence of their transgression. This should be a lesson for people who know.
arabic_uthmani: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We saved those who believed and led a righteous life.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Lot said to his people, “How could you commit such an abomination while you see?
arabic_uthmani: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “You practice sex with the men, lustfully, instead of the women. Indeed, you are ignorant people.”
arabic_uthmani: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The only response from his people was their saying, “Banish Lot’s family from your town; they are people who wish to be pure.”
arabic_uthmani: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ ءَالَ لُوطٍ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Consequently, we saved him and his family, except his wife; we counted her among the doomed.
arabic_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَـٰهَا مِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We showered them with a certain shower; a miserable shower upon people who had been warned.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Praise be to GOD and peace b< upon His servants whom He chose. Is GOD better, or the idols some people set up?”
arabic_uthmani: قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ۗ ءَآللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Surely, you are receiving the Quran from a Most Wise, Omniscient.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Who is the One who created the heavens and the earth? Who is the One who sends down to you from the sky water, whereby we produce gardens full of beauty—you could not possibly manufacture its trees? Is it another god with GOD? Indeed, they are people who deviate.
arabic_uthmani: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنۢبِتُوا۟ شَجَرَهَآ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Who is the One who made the earth habitable, made in it rivers, placed on it mountains, and created a barrier between the two waters? Is it another god with GOD? Indeed, most of them do not know.
arabic_uthmani: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَـٰلَهَآ أَنْهَـٰرًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Who is the One who rescues the needy when they call upon Him, relieves adversity, and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is it another god with GOD? Rarely do you take heed.
arabic_uthmani: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Who is the One who guides you in the darkness of land and sea? Who is the One who sends the winds with good news, signaling His mercy? Is it another god with GOD? Most exalted is GOD, above having any partner.
arabic_uthmani: أَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦٓ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ تَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Who is the One who initiates the creation, then repeats it? Who is the One who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Is it another god with GOD? Say, “Show me your proof, if you are truthful.”
arabic_uthmani: أَمَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “No one in the heavens and the earth knows the future except GOD. They do not even perceive how or when they will be resurrected.”
arabic_uthmani: قُل لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْغَيْبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: In fact, their knowledge about the Hereafter is confused. They even harbor doubts about it. They are totally heedless thereof.
arabic_uthmani: بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهَا ۖ بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who disbelieved said, “After we turn into dust, and also our parents, do we get brought out?
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ أَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “We have been given the same promise in the past. These are nothing but tales from the past.”
arabic_uthmani: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَـٰذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Roam the earth and note the consequences for the guilty.”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Recall that Moses said to his family, “I have seen a fire; let me bring you some news therefrom, or bring a torch to warm you up.”
arabic_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do not grieve over them, and do not be annoyed by their scheming.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُن فِى ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They say, “When will that promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”
arabic_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “You are already suffering some of the retribution you challenge.”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

english_1989: Your Lord is full of grace towards the people, but most of them are unappreciative.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And your Lord fully knows what their chests hide, and what they declare.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: There is nothing in the heavens and the earth that is absent; everything is in a profound record.
