english_1989: It is evident to those who are blessed with knowledge that this revelation from your Lord to you is indeed the truth, and that it guides to the path of the Almighty, the Most Praised.
arabic_uthmani: وَيَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who disbelieved said, “We can show you a man who tells you that after you are torn apart you will be created anew.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “Is he fabricating lies about GOD, or is he crazy?” Indeed, those who disbelieve in the Hereafter have incurred the worst retribution, for they have gone far astray.
arabic_uthmani: أَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۗ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلضَّلَـٰلِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Have they not seen all the things in front of them and behind them, in the heaven and the earth? If we willed, we could have caused the earth to swallow them, or caused masses to fall on them from the sky. This is a sign for every obedient servant.
arabic_uthmani: أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِن نَّشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Praise be to GOD, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, and appointer of the angels to be messengers with wings—two, three, and four (wings). He increases the creation as He wills. GOD is Omnipotent.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَـٰثَ وَرُبَـٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Anyone seeking dignity should know that to GOD belongs all dignity. To Him ascends the good words, and He exalts the righteous works. As for those who scheme evil works, they incur severe retribution; the scheming of such people is destined to fail.
arabic_uthmani: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ ٱلْكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ وَٱلْعَمَلُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُ يَرْفَعُهُۥ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۖ وَمَكْرُ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD created you from dust, then from a tiny drop, then He caused you to reproduce through your spouses. No female becomes pregnant, nor gives birth, without His knowledge. No one survives for a long life, and no one’s life is snapped short, except in accordance with a pre-existing record. This is easy for GOD.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ۚ وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And the two seas are not the same; one is fresh and potable, while the other is salty and undrinkable. From each of them you eat tender meat, and extract jewelry to wear. And you see the ships sailing therein, seeking His bounties, that you may be appreciative.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْبَحْرَانِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَآئِغٌ شَرَابُهُۥ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ ۖ وَمِن كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا ۖ وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night. He has committed the sun and the moon to run for a predetermined period of time. Such is GOD your Lord; to Him belongs all kingship. Any idols you set up besides Him do not possess as much a J’ The Idols*
arabic_uthmani: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you call on them, they cannot hear you. Even if they hear you, they cannot respond to you. On the Day of Resurrection, they disown you. None informs you like the Most Cognizant.
arabic_uthmani: إِن تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوا۟ دُعَآءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوا۟ مَا ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O people, you are the ones who need GOD, while GOD is in no need, Most Praiseworthy.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If He wills, He can get rid of you and substitute a new creation.
arabic_uthmani: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: This is not too difficult for GOD.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: No soul can carry the sins of another soul. If a soul that is loaded with sins implores to have part of its load removed, no other soul can carry any part of it, even if they are related. The only people to heed your warnings are those who reverence their Lord, even when alone in their privacy, and observe the contact prayers (Salat). Whoever purifies his soul, does so for his own good. To GOD is the final destiny.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰٓ ۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
english_transcription_note: Checked against the rendered 1989 source page.
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The blind and the seer are not equal.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When GOD showers any people with mercy, no force can stop it. And if He withholds it, no force, other than He, can send it. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Nor are the darkness and the light.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتُ وَلَا ٱلنُّورُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Nor are the coolness and the heat.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا ٱلظِّلُّ وَلَا ٱلْحَرُورُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Nor are the living and the dead; GOD causes whomever He wills to hear. You cannot make hearers out of those in the graves.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَحْيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلْأَمْوَٰتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَّن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You are no more than a warner.
arabic_uthmani: إِنْ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have sent you with the truth, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner. Every community must receive a warner.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If they disbelieve you, those before them have also disbelieved. Their messengers went to them with clear proofs, and the Psalms, and the enlightening scriptures.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Subsequently, I punished those who disbelieved; how terrible was My retribution!
arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do you not realize that GOD sends down from the sky water, whereby we produce fruits of various colors? Even the mountains have different colors; the peaks are white, or red, or some other color. And the ravens are black.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٍ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Also, the people, the animals, and the livestock come in various colors. This is why the people who truly reverence GOD are the knowledgeable. GOD is Almighty, Forgiving.
arabic_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Surely, those who recite the book of GOD, observe the contact prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them they spend secretly and publicly, are engaged in an enterprise that never fails.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَـٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَـٰرَةً لَّن تَبُورَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O people, remember GOD’s blessings upon you. Is there any creator other than GOD who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? There is no other god besides Him. How could you deviate?
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ هَلْ مِنْ خَـٰلِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: For He will pay them generously, and will multiply His bounties to them. He is Forgiving, Appreciative.
arabic_uthmani: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: What we revealed to you in this scripture is the truth, consummating all previous scriptures. GOD is fully Cognizant of His servants, Seer.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We passed the scripture from generation to generation, and we let whomever we chose from among our servants receive it. Subsequently, some of them wronged their souls, others upheld it only part of the time, while others were eager to work righteousness, in accordance with GOD’s will— this is the greatest triumph.
arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They will enter the gardens of Eden, where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold, and pearls, and their garments will be made of silk.
arabic_uthmani: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They will say, “Praise GOD for removing all our worries. Our Lord is Forgiving, Appreciative.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “He has admitted us into the abode of eternal bliss, out of His grace. Never do we get bored herein, never do we get tired.”
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: As for those who disbelieved, they have incurred the fire of Hell, where they are never finished by death, nor is the retribution ever commuted for them. We thus requite those who are unappreciative.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا۟ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى كُلَّ كَفُورٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They will scream therein, “Our Lord, if you get us out of here, we will work righteousness, instead of the works we used to do.” Did we not give you a life-long chance, with continuous reminders for those who would take heed? And the warner went to you. Therefore, suffer (the consequences). The transgressors will have no helpers.
arabic_uthmani: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD is the Knower of the future of the heavens and the earth. He is the Knower of all innermost thoughts.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَـٰلِمُ غَيْبِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth. Subsequently, whoever disbelieves does so to his own detriment. The disbelief of the disbelievers only increases their Lord’s abhorrence towards them. The disbelief of the disbelievers only plunges them deeper into loss.
arabic_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If they disbelieve you, messengers before you have been disbelieved. GOD is in control of all things.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Consider the idols you have set up besides GOD; show me what on earth have they created.” Do they own any partnership in the heavens? Have we given them a book wherein there is no doubt? Indeed, what the transgressors promise one another is no more than an illusion.
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD is the One who holds the heavens and the earth, lest they vanish. If anyone else is to hold them, they will most certainly vanish. He is Clement, Forgiving.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They swore by GOD solemnly that if a warner went to them, they would be better than any other congregation! Now that the warner did come to them, this only plunged them deeper into aversion.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They resorted to arrogance on earth, and evil scheming. However, evil schemes backfire on those who scheme them. Should they expect anything but the fate of those who did the same things in the past? You will find that GOD’s system is never changeable; you will Find that GOD’s system is immutable.
arabic_uthmani: ٱسْتِكْبَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ ٱلسَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلْمَكْرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِۦ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They were even stronger. Nothing can be hidden from GOD in the heavens, nor on earth. He is Omniscient, Omnipotent.
arabic_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If GOD were to punish the people for their sins, He would not leave a single creature on earth. But He respites them for a predetermined interim. Once their interim is fulfilled, then GOD is Seer of His servants. <
arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O people, GOD’s promise is truth; do not be distracted by this lowly life. Do not be diverted from GOD by an illusion.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The devil is your enemy, so treat him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be the dwellers of Hell.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَٱتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوا۟ حِزْبَهُۥ لِيَكُونُوا۟ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who disbelieved have incurred a severe retribution, and those who believed and led a righteous life have deserved forgiveness and a great recompense.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: What if one’s evil work is adorned in his eyes, until he thinks it is righteous? GOD thus sends astray whomever He wills, and He guides whomever He wills. Therefore, do not grieve over them. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.
arabic_uthmani: أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًا ۖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَٰتٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD is the One who sends the winds, to stir up clouds, then we drive them towards barren lands, and revive such lands after they were dead. Thus is the resurrection.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَسُقْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلنُّشُورُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Y.S.*
arabic_uthmani: يسٓ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: It is the same whether you warn them or not, they do not believe.*
arabic_uthmani: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You will be heeded only by those who uphold this message, and reverence the Most Gracious in their privacy. Give them good news of forgiveness and a generous recompense.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We will certainly revive the dead. We record everything they do during their life, as well as the consequences that continue after their death. Everything we have counted in a profound book.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَـٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Cite for them the example of people in one community who received the messengers.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When we sent to them two (messengers), they disbelieved them, then we supported them by a third. They said, “We are (God’s) messengers to you.”
arabic_uthmani: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They said, “You are no more than human beings like us. The Most Gracious did not reveal anything. You are really liars.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They said, “Our Lord knows that we have been sent to vou.
arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “Our sole mission is to deliver the message.”
arabic_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They said, “We consider you bad omens. Unless you refrain from this, we will surely stone you, or afflict you with painful retribution.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They said, “Your omen depends on you, now that you are reminded. You are transgressing people.”

english_1989: All it took was one blow, whereupon they were stilled.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Surely, you are one of the messengers.*

arabic_uthmani: يَـٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ

english_1989: One sign for them is the dead land: we revive it and produce from it grains for their food.
arabic_uthmani: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَـٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And we grow in it gardens of date palms, and grapes. And we cause springs to gush out therein.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: This is to provide them with fruits, and to let them manufacture what they need. Would they be thankful?
arabic_uthmani: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Glory be to the One who created all kinds of plants from the earth, as well as themselves, and other creations that they do not even know.
arabic_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Another sign for them is the night: we remove the daylight therefrom, whereupon they are in darkness.
arabic_uthmani: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And the sun sets into a specific location, according to the design of the Almighty, the Omniscient.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And the moon we designed in stages, until it becomes like an old curved sheath.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: On a straight path.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Another sign for them is that we carried their forefathers on the loaded ark.
arabic_uthmani: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Instead, we shower them with mercy, and let them enjoy for awhile.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Yet, when they are told, “Learn from your past, to work righteousness for your future that you may attain mercy,”

english_1989: No matter what kind of sign is sent to them from their Lord, they consistently disregard it.

english_1989: This is the revelation from the Almighty, Most Merciful.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They will not even have time to make a will, nor will they return to their people.

english_1989: All it takes is one blow, whereupon they are summoned before us.

english_1989: On that day, no soul will be wronged in the least. You will be paid precisely for whatever you did.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They abide with their spouses in beautiful shade, enjoying comfortable furnishings.
arabic_uthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They will have fruits therein; they will have anything they wish.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Greetings of peace from a Most Merciful Lord.

arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: As for you, O guilty ones, you will be set aside. The Other

english_1989: “Except Your worshipers who are devoted absolutely to You alone.”
arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He said, “This is the truth, and truth is all that I utter.
arabic_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “I will fill Hell with you and all those who follow you.”
arabic_uthmani: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “I do not ask you for any wage, and I am not an imposter.
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “This is a reminder for the world.
arabic_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “And you will certainly find out in awhile.”
arabic_uthmani: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do they own the treasures of your Lord’s mercy? He is the Almighty, the Grantor.
arabic_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: This is a revelation of the scripture, from GOD, the Almighty, the Wise.
arabic_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “O My servants who believed, you shall observe your Lord.” For those who worked righteousness in this world, a good reward. GOD’s earth is spacious, and those who steadfastly persevere will receive their recompense without limits.
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “I have been commanded to worship GOD, devoting the religion absolutely to Him alone.
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “And I was commanded to be the utmost submitter.”
arabic_uthmani: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “I fear, if I disobeyed my Lord, the retribution of a great day.”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “GOD is the only One I worship, devoting my religion absolutely to Him alone.
arabic_uthmani: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُۥ دِينِى
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “Therefore, worship whatever you wish besides Him.” Say, “The real losers are those who lose their souls, and their families, on the Day of Resurrection.” Most certainly, this is the worst loss.
arabic_uthmani: فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They will have masses of fire on top of them, and under them. GOD thus alerts His servants. O My servants, you shall reverence Me.
arabic_uthmani: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ ۚ يَـٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: As for those who discard the worship of all idols, and devoted themselves totally to GOD, they have the good news. Give good news to My servants.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They are the ones who examine all words, then follow the best. These are the ones whom GOD has guided; these are the ones who possess intelligence.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: For those who have incurred the retribution, can you save those who are already in Hell?
arabic_uthmani: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We sent down to you this scripture, truthfully, so worship GOD alone, devoting your religion to Him alone.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: As for those who reverence their Lord, they will have mansions upon mansions constructed for them, with flowing streams. This is GOD’s promise, and GOD never breaks His promise.
arabic_uthmani: لَـٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do you not see that GOD sends down from the sky water, then places it into underground wells, then produces with it plants of various colors, then they grow until they turn yellow, and become hay? This should be a reminder for those who possess intelligence.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَـٰبِيعَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَـٰمًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If GOD renders one’s heart content with Islam, he will be following a light from his Lord. Therefore, woe to those whose hearts are hardened against GOD’s message; they have gone far astray.
arabic_uthmani: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَـٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْقَـٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD has revealed herein the best Hadith', a book that is consistent, and points out both ways (to Heaven and Hell). The skins of those who reverence their Lord cringe therefrom, then their skins and their hearts soften for GOD’s message. Such is GOD’s guidance; He bestows it upon whomever He wills. As for those sent astray by GOD, nothing can guide them.
arabic_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَـٰبًا مُّتَشَـٰبِهًا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: What is better than saving one’s face from the terrible retribution on the Day of Resurrection? The transgressors will be told, “Suffer the consequences you have earned.”
arabic_uthmani: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِى بِوَجْهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Others before them have disbelieved and, consequently, the retribution afflicted them whence they never expected.
arabic_uthmani: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD has condemned them to humiliation in this life, and the retribution in the Hereafter will be far worse, if they only knew. Quran: The Only Source
arabic_uthmani: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخِزْىَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have cited for the people every kind of example in this Quran, that they may take heed.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: An Arabic Quran, without any ambiguity, that they may be righteous
arabic_uthmani: قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِى عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD cites the example of a man who deals with disputing partners (Hadith), compared to a man who deals with only one consistent source (Quran). Are they the same? Praise be to GOD; most of them do not know.
arabic_uthmani: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَـٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Absolutely, the religion shall be devoted to GOD alone. Those who set up idols besides Him say, “We idolize them only to bring us closer to GOD; they are in a good position!” GOD will judge them regarding their disputes. GOD does not guide any liar, unappreciative.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَـٰذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You (Muhammad) will surely die, just like they will die.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: On the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, you people will blame one another.
arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Who is more evil than one who attributes lies to GOD, while disbelieving in the truth that has come to him? Is Hell not a just requital for the disbelievers?
arabic_uthmani: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: On the other hand, those who promote the truth, and believe therein, are the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ ۙ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They get anything they wish, at their Lord. Such is the reward for the pious.
arabic_uthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD remits their sinful works, and rewards them generously for their righteous works.
arabic_uthmani: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Is GOD not sufficient for His servant? They frighten you with the idols they set up besides Him. Whomever GOD sends astray, nothing can guide him.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And whomever GOD guides, nothing can send him astray. Is GOD not Almighty, Avenger?
arabic_uthmani: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّ ۗ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِى ٱنتِقَامٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you ask them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” they will say, “GOD.” Say, “What about the idols you set up besides GOD? If GOD willed any adversity for me, can they relieve such an adversity? And if He willed a blessing for me, can they prevent such a blessing?” Say, “GOD is sufficient for me.” In Him the trusters shall trust.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَـٰشِفَـٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوْ أَرَادَنِى بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَـٰتُ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “O my people, do your best, and I will do my best; you will surely find out.
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَـٰمِلٌ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If GOD wanted to have a son, He could have chosen whomever He willed from among His creation. Be He glorified; He is GOD, the One, the Supreme.
arabic_uthmani: لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “(You will find out) who has incurred shameful punishment, and has deserved an eternal retribution.”
arabic_uthmani: مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have revealed the scripture through you for the people, truthfully. Then, whoever is guided is guided for his own good, and whoever goes astray goes astray to his own detriment. You are not their advocate.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD puts the souls to rest at the time of death, and at the time of sleep. Thus, while some are put to death during their sleep, others are allowed to continue living for a predetermined interim. This should provide lessons for people who reflect.
arabic_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَٱلَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ ٱلَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Have they invented intercessors to mediate between them and GOD' Say, “What if they do not possess any power, nor understanding?”
arabic_uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَ ۚ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “All intercession belongs to GOD.” To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth, then to Him you will be returned.
arabic_uthmani: قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ جَمِيعًا ۖ لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When GOD ALONE is mentioned, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion. But when others are mentioned besides Him, they rejoice.*
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ ٱشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Our god, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of all secrets and declarations, You are the only One who judges among You servants regarding their disputes.”
arabic_uthmani: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ عَـٰلِمَ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِى مَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If those who transgressed owned everything on earth, even twice as much, they would readily give it up to avoid the terrible retribution on the Day of Resurrection. They will be shown by GOD what they never expected.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَحْتَسِبُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The sinful works they had earned will be shown to them, and the very things they used to mock will come back to haunt them.
arabic_uthmani: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If the human is touched by adversity, he implores us, but as soon as we bestow a blessing upon him, he says, “I attained this because of my cleverness!” Indeed, this is only a test, but most of them do not know.
arabic_uthmani: فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَـٰهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هِىَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He created the heavens and the earth truthfully. He rolls the night over the day, and rolls the day over the night.* He committed the sun and the moon, each running for a finite period. Absolutely, He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
arabic_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those before them have uttered the same thing, but their earnings did not help them in the least.
arabic_uthmani: قَدْ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They suffered the consequences of their evil works. Similarly, the transgressors among the present generation will suffer the consequences of their evil works; they cannot escape.
arabic_uthmani: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do they not realize that GOD is the One who increases the provision for whomever He chooses, and withholds it? These are lessons for people who believe.
arabic_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Proclaim: “O My servants who exceeded the limits, never despair of GOD’s mercy. GOD forgives all sins. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall obey your Lord, and submit to Him totally, before the retribution overtakes you, then you cannot be helped.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَنِيبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And follow the best path that is pointed out for you by your Lord, before the retribution overtakes you suddenly when you least expect it.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَحْسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Lest a soul may say, “How sorry I am for disregarding GOD’s commandments; I was certainly one of the mockers.”
arabic_uthmani: أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَـٰحَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِى جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّـٰخِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Or say, “Had GOD guided me, I would have been with the righteous.”
arabic_uthmani: أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Or say, when it sees the retribution, “If I get another chance, I will work righteousness.”
arabic_uthmani: أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Yes indeed (you did get enough chances). My revelations came to you, but you rejected them, turned arrogant, and were a disbeliever.
arabic_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ ءَايَـٰتِى فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He created you from one person, then created from him his mate. He sent down to you eight kinds of livestock. He creates you in your mothers’ bellies, creation after creation, in three layers of darkness. Such is GOD your Lord. To Him belongs all kingship. There is no other god besides Him. How could you deviate?
arabic_uthmani: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍ ثَلَـٰثٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: On the Day of Resurrection you will see the faces of those who lied about GOD covered with misery. Is Hell not the right retribution for the arrogant ones?
arabic_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And GOD will save those who observed righteousness and will reward them. No harm will touch them, nor will they have any worries.
arabic_uthmani: وَيُنَجِّى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD is the Creator of all things, and He is in full control of all things.
arabic_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: To Him belongs all decisions in the heavens and the earth, and those who disbelieve in GOD’s revelations are the real losers.
arabic_uthmani: لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Is it other than GOD you exhort me to worship, O ignorant ones?”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأْمُرُوٓنِّىٓ أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: It has been revealed to you, and to those before you that if you ever commit idol worship, all your works will be nullified, and you will be with the losers.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ

english_1989: Therefore, you shall worship GOD alone, and be appreciative.
arabic_uthmani: بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They can never fathom the greatness of GOD. The whole earth is within His fist on the Day of Resurrection. In fact, the universes are folded within His right hand.* Be He glorified; He is much too high above needing any partners.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ وَٱلْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ مَطْوِيَّـٰتٌۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The horn is blown, whereupon everyone in the heavens and the earth is struck dead, except those whom GOD wills. Then it is blown again, whereupon they rise up, looking.
arabic_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنظُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Then the earth shines with the light of its Lord. The record is presented, and the prophets and the witnesses are brought forth. Then everyone is judged equitably, without the least injustice.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَشْرَقَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ وَجِا۟ىٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you disbelieve, GOD does not need you. But He dislikes to see His servants make the wrong decision. If you decide to be appreciative, He approves it for you. No soul bears the sins of any other soul. Ultimately, to your Lord is your return, then He will inform you of everything you had done. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
arabic_uthmani: إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Every soul is paid for whatever it did. He is fully aware of everything they have done.
arabic_uthmani: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who disbelieved are led to Hell in throngs. When they get to it, and its gates are opened, its guards will say, “Did you not receive messengers from among you, who recited to you the revelations of your Lord, and warned you about meeting this day?” They will answer, “Yes. But the word ‘retribution’ was already stamped upon the disbelievers.”
arabic_uthmani: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا ۚ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: It will be said, “Enter the gates of Hell, wherein you abide forever.” What a miserable destiny for the arrogant.
arabic_uthmani: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who reverenced their Lord will be led to Paradise in throngs. When they get to it, and its gates are opened, its guards will say, “Peace be upon you; you have won. Therefore, you abide herein forever.”
arabic_uthmani: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوهَا خَـٰلِدِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They will say, “Praise be to GOD, who fulfilled His promise to us, and made us inherit the earth, enjoying Paradise as we please.” What a beautiful recompense for the workers!
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُۥ وَأَوْرَثَنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَآءُ ۖ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَـٰمِلِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You will see the angels floating around the throne, glorifying and praising their Lord. After the equitable judgment is issued to all, it is proclaimed: “Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.”
arabic_uthmani: وَتَرَى ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ ٱلْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When the human being is afflicted, he implores his Lord, sincerely devoted to Him. But as soon as He blesses him, he forgets his previous imploring, sets up idols to rank with GOD and diverts others from His path. Say, “Enjoy your disbelief temporarily; you have incurred Hell.”
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Is it not better to be one of those who meditate in the night, prostrating and staying up, being aware of the Hereafter, and seeking the mercy of their Lord? Say, “Are those who know equal to those who do not know?” Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.
arabic_uthmani: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَـٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَآئِمًا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O people, observe your Lord; the One who created you from one being and created from it its mate, then spread from the two many men and women. You shall regard GOD, by whom you swear, and regard the parents. GOD is watching over you.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَآءً ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى تَسَآءَلُونَ بِهِۦ وَٱلْأَرْحَامَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who consume the orphans’ properties unjustly, eat fire into their bellies, and incur Hell.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ أَمْوَٰلَ ٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ ظُلْمًا إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُونَ فِى بُطُونِهِمْ نَارًا ۖ وَسَيَصْلَوْنَ سَعِيرًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Anyone who emigrates in the cause of GOD will find on earth great bounties and richness. Anyone who gives up his home, emigrating to GOD and His messenger, then death catches up with him, his recompense will be granted by GOD. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَن يُهَاجِرْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ يَجِدْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُرَٰغَمًا كَثِيرًا وَسَعَةً ۚ وَمَن يَخْرُجْ مِنۢ بَيْتِهِۦ مُهَاجِرًا إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ يُدْرِكْهُ ٱلْمَوْتُ فَقَدْ وَقَعَ أَجْرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When you travel, during war, you commit no error by shortening your contact prayers (Salat), if you fear that the disbelievers may attack you. Surely, the disbelievers are your ardent enemies.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَقْصُرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ إِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَن يَفْتِنَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ كَانُوا۟ لَكُمْ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you are with them, and lead the contact prayer (Salat) for them, let some of you stand guard; let them hold their weapons, and let them stand behind you as you prostrate. Then, let the group that has not prayed take their turn praying with you, and let the others stand guard and hold their weapons. Those who disbelieved wish to see you neglect your weapons and your equipment, in order to attack you once and for all. You commit no error, if you are hampered by rain or injury, if you put down your weapons, so long as you remain alert. GOD has prepared for the disbelievers a shameful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا كُنتَ فِيهِمْ فَأَقَمْتَ لَهُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَلْتَقُمْ طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنْهُم مَّعَكَ وَلْيَأْخُذُوٓا۟ أَسْلِحَتَهُمْ فَإِذَا سَجَدُوا۟ فَلْيَكُونُوا۟ مِن وَرَآئِكُمْ وَلْتَأْتِ طَآئِفَةٌ أُخْرَىٰ لَمْ يُصَلُّوا۟ فَلْيُصَلُّوا۟ مَعَكَ وَلْيَأْخُذُوا۟ حِذْرَهُمْ وَأَسْلِحَتَهُمْ ۗ وَدَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ تَغْفُلُونَ عَنْ أَسْلِحَتِكُمْ وَأَمْتِعَتِكُمْ فَيَمِيلُونَ عَلَيْكُم مَّيْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِن كَانَ بِكُمْ أَذًى مِّن مَّطَرٍ أَوْ كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰٓ أَن تَضَعُوٓا۟ أَسْلِحَتَكُمْ ۖ وَخُذُوا۟ حِذْرَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا مُّهِينًا
