Once you complete the pilgrimage, you may hunt.* Do not be provoked by your conflicts with people who prevented you from reaching the Sacred Mosque into aggression. You shall cooperate in matters of righteousness and piety; do not cooperate in matters that are sinful and evil. You shall observe GOD. GOD is strict in enforcing retribution.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُحِلُّوا۟ شَعَـٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا ٱلشَّهْرَ ٱلْحَرَامَ وَلَا ٱلْهَدْىَ وَلَا ٱلْقَلَـٰٓئِدَ وَلَآ ءَآمِّينَ ٱلْبَيْتَ ٱلْحَرَامَ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرِضْوَٰنًا ۚ وَإِذَا حَلَلْتُمْ فَٱصْطَادُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَـَٔانُ قَوْمٍ أَن صَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ أَن تَعْتَدُوا۟ ۘ وَتَعَاوَنُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلْبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَلَا تَعَاوَنُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Recall that Moses said to his people, “O my people, remember GOD’s blessings upon you: He appointed prophets from among you, made you kings, and granted you what He never granted any other people.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَعَلَ فِيكُمْ أَنۢبِيَآءَ وَجَعَلَكُم مُّلُوكًا وَءَاتَىٰكُم مَّا لَمْ يُؤْتِ أَحَدًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “O my people, enter the holy land that GOD has decreed for you, and do not turn back, lest you become losers.”
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They said, “O Moses, there are powerful people in it, and we will never enter it, unless they get out. If they get out, we are entering.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّ فِيهَا قَوْمًا جَبَّارِينَ وَإِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَا حَتَّىٰ يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا فَإِن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّا دَٰخِلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Two men who were reverent and blessed by GOD said, “Just enter the gate. If you just enter it, you will prevail. You shall trust in GOD, if you are believers.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَجُلَانِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱدْخُلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمْ غَـٰلِبُونَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُوٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They said, “O Moses, we will never enter it, so long as they are in it. Therefore, go, you and your Lord, and fight. We are sitting right here.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَآ أَبَدًا مَّا دَامُوا۟ فِيهَا ۖ فَٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَـٰتِلَآ إِنَّا هَـٰهُنَا قَـٰعِدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He said, “My Lord, I can only control myself and my brother. So permit us to part company with the wicked people.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ إِلَّا نَفْسِى وَأَخِى ۖ فَٱفْرُقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He said, “Henceforth, it is forbidden them for forty years, during which they will roam the earth aimlessly. Do not grieve over such wicked people.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ۛ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً ۛ يَتِيهُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Recite for them the history of Adam's’ two sons, truthfully. They made an offering, and it was accepted from one, but not from the other. He said, “I will kill you.” He said, “GOD accepts only from the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْءَاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “If you extend your hand to kill me, I am not extending my hand to kill you. I fear GOD, Lord of the universe.
arabic_uthmani: لَئِنۢ بَسَطتَ إِلَىَّ يَدَكَ لِتَقْتُلَنِى مَآ أَنَا۠ بِبَاسِطٍ يَدِىَ إِلَيْكَ لِأَقْتُلَكَ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “I want you, not me, to bear my sin and your sin, then you end up with the dwellers of Hell. Such is the requital for the transgressors.”
arabic_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أُرِيدُ أَن تَبُوٓأَ بِإِثْمِى وَإِثْمِكَ فَتَكُونَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Prohibited for you are animals that die of themselves, blood, the meat of pigs,* and animals dedicated to other than GOD. {Animals that die of themselves include those) strangled, struck with an object, fallen from height, gored, attacked by a wild animal—unless you save your animal before it dies—and animals sacrificed on altars. Also prohibited is dividing the meat through a game of chance; this is an abomination. Today, those who disbelieved have given up concerning {the eradication of) your religion; do not fear them and fear Me instead. Today, I have completed your religion, perfected My blessing upon you, and I have decreed Islam as the religion for you. If one is forced by starvation {to eat prohibited food), without being deliberately sinful, then GOD is Forgiver, Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ وَٱلدَّمُ وَلَحْمُ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ وَٱلْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَٱلْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَٱلْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَٱلنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَآ أَكَلَ ٱلسَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتُمْ وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى ٱلنُّصُبِ وَأَن تَسْتَقْسِمُوا۟ بِٱلْأَزْلَـٰمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ ۗ ٱلْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن دِينِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِ ۚ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِى وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمَ دِينًا ۚ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ فِى مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍ لِّإِثْمٍ ۙ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: His ego provoked him into killing his brother. He killed him, and ended up with the losers.
arabic_uthmani: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD then sent a raven to scratch the soil, to teach him how to bury his brother’s corpse. He said, “Woe to me; I failed to be as intelligent as this raven, and bury my brother’s corpse.” He became ridden with remorse.
arabic_uthmani: فَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ غُرَابًا يَبْحَثُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيُرِيَهُۥ كَيْفَ يُوَٰرِى سَوْءَةَ أَخِيهِ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰٓ أَعَجَزْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِثْلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْغُرَابِ فَأُوَٰرِىَ سَوْءَةَ أَخِى ۖ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلنَّـٰدِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Because of this, we decreed for the Children of Israel that anyone who murders a soul who did not commit murder or horrendous crimes, is as if he murdered all the people, and anyone who spares a life is as if he spared the lives of all the people. Our messengers went to them with clear revelations, but most of them, after all this, are still transgressing. Capital Punishment: When is it Justified?
arabic_uthmani: مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَٰلِكَ كَتَبْنَا عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنَّهُۥ مَن قَتَلَ نَفْسًۢا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ أَوْ فَسَادٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَآ أَحْيَا ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ إِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَمُسْرِفُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The just retribution for those who fight GOD and His messenger, and commit horrendous crimes, is to be killed, or crucified, or to cut their hands and feet on alternate sides, or to be banished from the land. This is to humiliate them in this life, then they suffer terrible retribution in the Hereafter.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا جَزَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَارِبُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا أَن يُقَتَّلُوٓا۟ أَوْ يُصَلَّبُوٓا۟ أَوْ تُقَطَّعَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ أَوْ يُنفَوْا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لَهُمْ خِزْىٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Exempted are those who repent before you overcome them. You should know that GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, observe GOD and seek the ways and means to Him, and strive in His cause, that you may succeed.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱبْتَغُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ وَجَـٰهِدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Surely, those who disbelieved, if they possessed everything on earth, even twice as much, and offered it all as ransom to spare them the retribution on the Day of Resurrection, it would not be accepted from them; they have incurred a painful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لِيَفْتَدُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَا تُقُبِّلَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They will want to exit Hell, but alas, they can never exit therefrom; their retribution is eternal.
arabic_uthmani: يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمَا هُم بِخَـٰرِجِينَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The thief, male or female, you shall mark their hands* as a punishment for their crime, and to serve as a deterrent from GOD. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلسَّارِقُ وَٱلسَّارِقَةُ فَٱقْطَعُوٓا۟ أَيْدِيَهُمَا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَسَبَا نَكَـٰلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If one repents after committing this crime, and reforms, GOD redeems him. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: فَمَن تَابَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ظُلْمِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They consult you concerning what is lawful for them; say, “Lawful for you are all good things, including what trained dogs and falcons catch for you.” You train them according to GOD’s teachings. You may eat what they catch for you, and mention GOD’s name thereupon. You shall observe GOD. GOD is most efficient in reckoning.
arabic_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَآ أُحِلَّ لَهُمْ ۖ قُلْ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتُ ۙ وَمَا عَلَّمْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَوَارِحِ مُكَلِّبِينَ تُعَلِّمُونَهُنَّ مِمَّا عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّآ أَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do you not know that GOD possesses the kingship of the heavens and the earth? He punishes whomever He wills, and forgives whomever He wills. GOD is Omnipotent.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you messenger, do not be saddened by those who hasten to disbelieve among those who said, “We believe,” with their mouths, while their hearts do not believe. Among the Jews, some listened to lies; they listened to people who never met you. They distorted the words out of context, then said, “If you are given this, accept it, but if you are given anything different, beware.” Whomever GOD wills to divert, you can do nothing to help him against GOD. These are the ones whom GOD wills not to cleanse their hearts. They have incurred humiliation in this world, and a terrible retribution in the Hereafter.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرَّسُولُ لَا يَحْزُنكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْكُفْرِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَلَمْ تُؤْمِن قُلُوبُهُمْ ۛ وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ ۛ سَمَّـٰعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ سَمَّـٰعُونَ لِقَوْمٍ ءَاخَرِينَ لَمْ يَأْتُوكَ ۖ يُحَرِّفُونَ ٱلْكَلِمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَوَاضِعِهِۦ ۖ يَقُولُونَ إِنْ أُوتِيتُمْ هَـٰذَا فَخُذُوهُ وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْتَوْهُ فَٱحْذَرُوا۟ ۚ وَمَن يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ فِتْنَتَهُۥ فَلَن تَمْلِكَ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُطَهِّرَ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۚ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌ ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They listen to lies, and eat from illicit earnings. If they come to you to judge among them, you may judge among them, or you may disregard them. If you choose to disregard them, they cannot harm you. But if you judge among them, you shall be equitable. GOD loves those who are equitable.
arabic_uthmani: سَمَّـٰعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ أَكَّـٰلُونَ لِلسُّحْتِ ۚ فَإِن جَآءُوكَ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُمْ أَوْ أَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ فَلَن يَضُرُّوكَ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَإِنْ حَكَمْتَ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Why should they ask you to judge among them, when they have the Torah, containing GOD’s law. They have chosen to disregard it. They are not believers.
arabic_uthmani: وَكَيْفَ يُحَكِّمُونَكَ وَعِندَهُمُ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ فِيهَا حُكْمُ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have sent down the Torah, containing guidance and light. Ruling in accordance with it were the prophets who submitted, as well as the rabbis and priests, as dictated to them in GOD’s scripture, and as witnessed by them. Therefore, do not reverence the people, and reverence Me instead. You shall not trade away My revelations for a cheap price. Anyone who does not rule in accordance with GOD’s revelations, these are the disbelievers.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ فِيهَا هُدًى وَنُورٌ ۚ يَحْكُمُ بِهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّونَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْلَمُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلرَّبَّـٰنِيُّونَ وَٱلْأَحْبَارُ بِمَا ٱسْتُحْفِظُوا۟ مِن كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ شُهَدَآءَ ۚ فَلَا تَخْشَوُا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱخْشَوْنِ وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِى ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And we decreed for them in it that: the soul for the soul, the eye for the eye, the nose for the nose, the ear for the ear, the tooth for the tooth, and an equivalent injury for any injury. If one forfeits what is due to him as a charity, it will atone for his sins. Anyone who does not rule in accordance with GOD’s revelations, these are the unjust.
arabic_uthmani: وَكَتَبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِيهَآ أَنَّ ٱلنَّفْسَ بِٱلنَّفْسِ وَٱلْعَيْنَ بِٱلْعَيْنِ وَٱلْأَنفَ بِٱلْأَنفِ وَٱلْأُذُنَ بِٱلْأُذُنِ وَٱلسِّنَّ بِٱلسِّنِّ وَٱلْجُرُوحَ قِصَاصٌ ۚ فَمَن تَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦ فَهُوَ كَفَّارَةٌ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Subsequent to them, we sent Jesus, son of Mary, confirming the previous scripture, the Torah. And we gave him the Gospel, containing guidance and light, and confirming the previous scripture, the Torah, and augmenting its guidance and light, and to enlighten the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ فِيهِ هُدًى وَنُورٌ وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَهُدًى وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The people of the Gospel shall rule in accordance with GOD’s revelations therein. Anyone who does not rule in accordance with GOD’s revelations, these are the wicked.
arabic_uthmani: وَلْيَحْكُمْ أَهْلُ ٱلْإِنجِيلِ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Then we revealed to you this scripture, truthfully, confirming previous scriptures, and superseding them. You shall rule among them in accordance with GOD’s revelations herein. Do not follow their wishes if they differ from the truth that came to you. For each of you, we have decreed laws and methodologies. Had GOD willed, He could have made you one congregation. But He thus puts you to the test through His revelations to you. Therefore, you shall race towards righteousness. To GOD is the final destiny of all of you, then He will inform you of everything you had disputed.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَمُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ عَمَّا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ لِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ شِرْعَةً وَمِنْهَاجًا ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall rule among them in accordance with GOD’s revelations to you. Do not follow their wishes, and beware lest they divert you from some of GOD’s revelations to you. If they turn away, then know that GOD wills to punish them for some of their sins. Surely, many people are wicked.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَنِ ٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَٱحْذَرْهُمْ أَن يَفْتِنُوكَ عَنۢ بَعْضِ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُصِيبَهُم بِبَعْضِ ذُنُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَفَـٰسِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Today, all good food is made lawful for you. The food of the people of the scripture is lawful for you. And you may marry the chaste women among the believers, as well as the chaste women among the followers of previous scripture, provided you pay them their due dowries. You shall maintain chastity, not committing adultery, nor taking secret lovers. If one rejects faith, all his work will be in vain, and in the Hereafter he will be with the losers.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتُ ۖ وَطَعَامُ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ حِلٌّ لَّكُمْ وَطَعَامُكُمْ حِلٌّ لَّهُمْ ۖ وَٱلْمُحْصَنَـٰتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُحْصَنَـٰتُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ إِذَآ ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ مُحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَـٰفِحِينَ وَلَا مُتَّخِذِىٓ أَخْدَانٍ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُۥ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Is it the rules of the days of ignorance that they want? Whose rules are better than GOD’s for those who have attained certainty?
arabic_uthmani: أَفَحُكْمَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ يَبْغُونَ ۚ وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ حُكْمًا لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies; they are allies of one another. Those among you who ally themselves with them belong with them. GOD does not guide the transgressors.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْيَهُودَ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۘ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنْهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You will see those with doubt in their hearts hasten to join them, saying, “We fear lest defeat may be our lot.” May GOD bring victory, or a command from Him, that causes them to regret their secret thoughts.
arabic_uthmani: فَتَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِيهِمْ يَقُولُونَ نَخْشَىٰٓ أَن تُصِيبَنَا دَآئِرَةٌ ۚ فَعَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِٱلْفَتْحِ أَوْ أَمْرٍ مِّنْ عِندِهِۦ فَيُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَسَرُّوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ نَـٰدِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The believers will then say, “Are these the same people who swore by GOD solemnly that they were with you?” Their works are nullified; they are the losers.
arabic_uthmani: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ ۙ إِنَّهُمْ لَمَعَكُمْ ۚ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, if you revert from your religion, GOD will substitute in your place people whom H< loves and they love Him, {people) who are humble with the believers, but stern with the disbelievers, and who strive in the cause of GOD without fear of any blame. Such is GOD’s blessing; He bestows it upon whomever He wills. GOD is Bounteous, Omniscient.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَن يَرْتَدَّ مِنكُمْ عَن دِينِهِۦ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِى ٱللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُۥٓ أَذِلَّةٍ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَعِزَّةٍ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ يُجَـٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَخَافُونَ لَوْمَةَ لَآئِمٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Your real allies are GOD and His messenger, and the believers who observe the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat), and they bow down.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا وَلِيُّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُمْ رَٰكِعُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Anyone who allies himself with GOD and His messenger, and those who believed, then GOD’s party are the victors.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَإِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, do not befriend those among the recipients of previous scripture who mock and ridicule your religion, nor shall you befriend the disbelievers. You shall observe GOD, if you are really believers.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَكُمْ هُزُوًا وَلَعِبًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَٱلْكُفَّارَ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When you call to the contact prayers (Salat), they mock and ridicule it. This is because they are people who do not understand.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا نَادَيْتُمْ إِلَى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ٱتَّخَذُوهَا هُزُوًا وَلَعِبًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “O people of the scripture, do you hate us because we believe in GOD, and in what was revealed to us, and in what was revealed in the past, and because most of you are wicked?”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ هَلْ تَنقِمُونَ مِنَّآ إِلَّآ أَنْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلُ وَأَنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, when you observe the contact prayers (Salat), you shall: (1) wash your faces, (2) wash your arms to the elbows, (3) wipe your heads, and (4) wash your feet to the ankles. If you were unclean due to sexual orgasm, you shall bathe. If you are ill, or traveling, or had any digestive excretion (urinary, fecal, or gas), or had sexual contact with the women, and you cannot find water, you shall observe the dry ablution (Tayammum) by touching clean dry soil, then rubbing your faces and hands. GOD does not wish to make the religion difficult for you; He wishes to cleanse you and to perfect His blessing upon you, that you may be appreciative.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا قُمْتُمْ إِلَى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ فَٱغْسِلُوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْمَرَافِقِ وَٱمْسَحُوا۟ بِرُءُوسِكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْكَعْبَيْنِ ۚ وَإِن كُنتُمْ جُنُبًا فَٱطَّهَّرُوا۟ ۚ وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰٓ أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَآءَ أَحَدٌ مِّنكُم مِّنَ ٱلْغَآئِطِ أَوْ لَـٰمَسْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا۟ مَآءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا۟ صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَٱمْسَحُوا۟ بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُم مِّنْهُ ۚ مَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيَجْعَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْ حَرَجٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُرِيدُ لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ وَلِيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Let me tell you who is worse in the sight of GOD: those who are condemned by GOD after incurring His wrath until He made them (as despicable as) monkeys and pigs, and the idol worshipers as well. These are far worse, and farther from the right path.”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكَ مَثُوبَةً عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ مَن لَّعَنَهُ ٱللَّهُ وَغَضِبَ عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْقِرَدَةَ وَٱلْخَنَازِيرَ وَعَبَدَ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ عَن سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When they come to you, they say, “We believe,” even though they were full of disbelief when they entered, and they were full of disbelief when they left. GOD is fully aware of everything they conceal.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا جَآءُوكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَقَد دَّخَلُوا۟ بِٱلْكُفْرِ وَهُمْ قَدْ خَرَجُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْتُمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You see many of them readily committing evil and transgressing, and eating from illicit earnings. Miserable indeed is what they used to do.
arabic_uthmani: وَتَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَأَكْلِهِمُ ٱلسُّحْتَ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If only the rabbis and the priests enjoined them from their sinful utterances and illicit earnings! Miserable indeed is what they used to commit.
arabic_uthmani: لَوْلَا يَنْهَىٰهُمُ ٱلرَّبَّـٰنِيُّونَ وَٱلْأَحْبَارُ عَن قَوْلِهِمُ ٱلْإِثْمَ وَأَكْلِهِمُ ٱلسُّحْتَ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The Jews even said, “GOD’s hand is tied down!” It is their hands that are tied down. They are condemned for uttering such a blasphemy. Instead, His hands are wide open, spending as He wills. For certain, your Lord’s revelations to you will cause many of them to plunge deeper into transgression and disbelief. Consequently, we have committed them to animosity and hatred among themselves until the Day of Resurrection. Whenever they ignite the flames of war, GOD puts them out. They roam the earth wickedly, and GOD dislikes the evildoers.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ مَغْلُولَةٌ ۚ غُلَّتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَلُعِنُوا۟ بِمَا قَالُوا۟ ۘ بَلْ يَدَاهُ مَبْسُوطَتَانِ يُنفِقُ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ ۚ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَـٰنًا وَكُفْرًا ۚ وَأَلْقَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ كُلَّمَآ أَوْقَدُوا۟ نَارًا لِّلْحَرْبِ أَطْفَأَهَا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If only the people of the scripture believe and lead a righteous life, we will then remit their sins, and admit them into gardens of bliss.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ لَكَفَّرْنَا عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If only they would uphold the Torah and the Gospel, and what is sent down to them herein from their Lord, they would be blessed with provisions from above them and from beneath their feet. Some of them are righteous, but many of them are evildoers.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِم مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ لَأَكَلُوا۟ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِم ۚ مِّنْهُمْ أُمَّةٌ مُّقْتَصِدَةٌ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ سَآءَ مَا يَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you messenger, deliver what is revealed to you from your Lord— until you do, you have not delivered His message—and GOD will protect you from the people. GOD does not guide the disbelieving people.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “O people of the scripture, you have no basis until you uphold the Torah, and the Gospel, and what is sent down to you herein from your Lord.” For sure, these revelations from your Lord will only cause many of them to plunge deeper into transgression and disbelief. Therefore, do not feel sorry for the disbelieving people.
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَسْتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ تُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۗ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَـٰنًا وَكُفْرًا ۖ فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Surely, those who believe, those who are Jewish, the converts, and the Christians; any of them who (1) believe in GOD and (2) the Last Day, and (3) lead a righteous life, will have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّـٰبِـُٔونَ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Remember GOD’s blessing upon you, and His covenant that He covenanted with you: you said, “We hear and we obey.” You shall observe GOD; GOD is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمِيثَـٰقَهُ ٱلَّذِى وَاثَقَكُم بِهِۦٓ إِذْ قُلْتُمْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have taken a covenant from the Children of Israel, and we sent to them messengers. Whenever a messenger went to them with what they disliked, some of them they rejected, and some they killed.
arabic_uthmani: لَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَـٰقَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ رُسُلًا ۖ كُلَّمَا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۢ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَرِيقًا كَذَّبُوا۟ وَفَرِيقًا يَقْتُلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They thought that they would not be tested, so they turned blind and deaf, then GOD redeemed them, but then many of them turned blind and deaf again GOD is Seer of everything they do.
arabic_uthmani: وَحَسِبُوٓا۟ أَلَّا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ فَعَمُوا۟ وَصَمُّوا۟ ثُمَّ تَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ عَمُوا۟ وَصَمُّوا۟ كَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Pagans indeed are those who say that GOD is the Messiah, son of Mary. The Messiah himself said, “O Children of Israel, you shall worship GOD; my Lord and your Lord.” Anyone who sets up any idol besides fJOTl GOD forbids Paradise for him, and his destiny is Hell. The wicked have no supporters.
arabic_uthmani: لَقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبَّكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Pagans indeed are those who say that GOD is a member of a trinity. There is no god except one god. Unless they refrain from saying this, those who disbelieve among them will incur painful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ثَالِثُ ثَلَـٰثَةٍ ۘ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّآ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۚ وَإِن لَّمْ يَنتَهُوا۟ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَيَمَسَّنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Would they not repent to GOD, and ask His forgiveness? GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَتُوبُونَ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The Messiah, son of Mary, is no more than a messenger like the messengers before him, and his mother a saint. Both of them used to eat the food. Note how we explain the revelations for them, and note how they still deviate!
arabic_uthmani: مَّا ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَأُمُّهُۥ صِدِّيقَةٌ ۖ كَانَا يَأْكُلَانِ ٱلطَّعَامَ ۗ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُبَيِّنُ لَهُمُ ٱلْءَايَـٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرْ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Would you worship besides GOD powerless idols who can neither harm you, nor benefit you? GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “O people of the scripture, do not transgress the limits of your religion beyond the truth, and do not follow the opinions of people who have gone astray, who have misled multitudes of people, and are far astray from the right path.”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَا تَغْلُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَ قَوْمٍ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ وَأَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا وَضَلُّوا۟ عَن سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Condemned by the tongue of David and of Jesus, son of Mary, are those who disbelieved among the Children of Israel. This is because they disobeyed and transgressed.
arabic_uthmani: لُعِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ لِسَانِ دَاوُۥدَ وَعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They did not enjoin one another from committing evil. Miserable indeed is what they used to do.
arabic_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ لَا يَتَنَاهَوْنَ عَن مُّنكَرٍ فَعَلُوهُ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, you shall be absolutely equitable, and observe GOD, when you serve as witnesses. Do not be provoked by your conflicts with some people into committing injustice. Be equitable, for it is more righteous. You shall observe GOD. GOD fully Cognizant of everything you do.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ قَوَّٰمِينَ لِلَّهِ شُهَدَآءَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَـَٔانُ قَوْمٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا۟ ۚ ٱعْدِلُوا۟ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You see many of them befriending those who disbelieved; miserable indeed is what their hands have sent forth on behalf of their souls. GOD is angry with them and, consequently, they will abide forever in retribution.
arabic_uthmani: تَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لَهُمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ أَن سَخِطَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَفِى ٱلْعَذَابِ هُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Had they believed in GOD, and the prophet, and in what was revealed to him herein, they would not have befriended them. But many of them are evil.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلنَّبِىِّ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَا ٱتَّخَذُوهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You will find that the worst enemies of the believers are the Jews and the idol worshipers. And you will find that the closest people in friendship to the believers are those who say, “We are Christian.” This is because they have priests and monks among them, and they are not arrogant.
arabic_uthmani: لَتَجِدَنَّ أَشَدَّ ٱلنَّاسِ عَدَٰوَةً لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلْيَهُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ ۖ وَلَتَجِدَنَّ أَقْرَبَهُم مَّوَدَّةً لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا نَصَـٰرَىٰ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ مِنْهُمْ قِسِّيسِينَ وَرُهْبَانًا وَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When they hear what was revealed to the messenger, you see their eyes flooded with tears as they recognize the truth therein. They say, “Our Lord, we have believed, so count us among the witnesses.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا۟ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ تَرَىٰٓ أَعْيُنَهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمْعِ مِمَّا عَرَفُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “Why should we not believe in GOD, and in the truth that has come to us, and hope that our Lord may admit us with the righteous people?”
arabic_uthmani: وَمَا لَنَا لَا نُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَنَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD rewards them for saying this, by admitting them into gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. Such is the reward for the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: فَأَثَـٰبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا قَالُوا۟ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: As for those who disbelieve and reject our revelations, they are the dwellers of Hell.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, do not prohibit good things that are made lawful by GOD. Do not transgress; GOD dislikes the transgressors.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُحَرِّمُوا۟ طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَعْتَدُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Eat from the good and lawful things that GOD has provided for you, and observe GOD, in whom you are believers.
arabic_uthmani: وَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَـٰلًا طَيِّبًا ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنتُم بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD does not hold you responsible for the mere utterance of oaths; He holds you responsible for your actual intentions. If you violate an oath, you shall atone by feeding ten poor people from the good food you offer to your own family, or clothing them, or by freeing a slave. If you cannot afford this, then you shall fast three days. This is the atonement for violating your oaths. You shall fulfill your oaths. GOD thus explains His revelations to you, that you may be appreciative.
arabic_uthmani: لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِٱللَّغْوِ فِىٓ أَيْمَـٰنِكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا عَقَّدتُّمُ ٱلْأَيْمَـٰنَ ۖ فَكَفَّـٰرَتُهُۥٓ إِطْعَامُ عَشَرَةِ مَسَـٰكِينَ مِنْ أَوْسَطِ مَا تُطْعِمُونَ أَهْلِيكُمْ أَوْ كِسْوَتُهُمْ أَوْ تَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَـٰثَةِ أَيَّامٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ كَفَّـٰرَةُ أَيْمَـٰنِكُمْ إِذَا حَلَفْتُمْ ۚ وَٱحْفَظُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD promises those who believe and lead a righteous life forgiveness and a great recompense.
arabic_uthmani: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ ۙ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, intoxicants, and gambling, and altars, and games of chance are abominations of the devil; you shall avoid them, that you may succeed.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْخَمْرُ وَٱلْمَيْسِرُ وَٱلْأَنصَابُ وَٱلْأَزْلَـٰمُ رِجْسٌ مِّنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ فَٱجْتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The devil wants to provoke animosity and hatred among you through intoxicants and gambling, and to distract you from remembering GOD and from observing the contact prayers (Salat). Will you then refrain?
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَن يُوقِعَ بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ فِى ٱلْخَمْرِ وَٱلْمَيْسِرِ وَيَصُدَّكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَعَنِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّنتَهُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall obey GOD and obey the messenger, and beware. If you turn away, then know that the sole duty of our messenger is to deliver the message efficiently.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَٱحْذَرُوا۟ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: No sin is committed by those who believe and lead a righteous life when they eat any food, so long as they observe the commandments, believe and lead a righteous life, then maintain their piety and faith, and continue to observe piety and righteousness. GOD loves the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: لَيْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوٓا۟ إِذَا مَا ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّأَحْسَنُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, GOD will test you with some game within reach of your hands and arrows (during pilgrimage). GOD thus distinguishes those among you who observe Him in their privacy. Those who transgress after this incur a painful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَيَبْلُوَنَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنَ ٱلصَّيْدِ تَنَالُهُۥٓ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَرِمَاحُكُمْ لِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَخَافُهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ فَمَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَهُۥ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, do not kill any game during pilgrimage. Anyone who kills any game on purpose, his fine shall be the same number of livestock as the number of game animals he killed. Let two equitable people among you judge, and make sure that the offerings reach the Ka‘bah. Otherwise, he may atone by feeding poor people, or by an equivalent fast to pay for his offense. GOD has pardoned past offenses. But if anyone returns to such an offense, GOD will avenge it. GOD is Almighty, Avenger.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْدَ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ ۚ وَمَن قَتَلَهُۥ مِنكُم مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَآءٌ مِّثْلُ مَا قَتَلَ مِنَ ٱلنَّعَمِ يَحْكُمُ بِهِۦ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ هَدْيًۢا بَـٰلِغَ ٱلْكَعْبَةِ أَوْ كَفَّـٰرَةٌ طَعَامُ مَسَـٰكِينَ أَوْ عَدْلُ ذَٰلِكَ صِيَامًا لِّيَذُوقَ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِۦ ۗ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا سَلَفَ ۚ وَمَنْ عَادَ فَيَنتَقِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنْهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: All fish of the sea are made lawful for you to eat. During pilgrimage, this will provide for you during your journey. You shall not hunt throughout the pilgrimage. You shall observe GOD, before whom you will be summoned.
arabic_uthmani: أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ صَيْدُ ٱلْبَحْرِ وَطَعَامُهُۥ مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِلسَّيَّارَةِ ۖ وَحُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَيْدُ ٱلْبَرِّ مَا دُمْتُمْ حُرُمًا ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD has consecrated the Ka'bah, the Sacred Mosque,* for the people. (He has also consecrated) the Sacred Months, the offerings (to the Sacred Mosque), and the garlands marking them. You should know that GOD knows everything in the heavens and the earth, and that GOD is Omniscient.
arabic_uthmani: جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَعْبَةَ ٱلْبَيْتَ ٱلْحَرَامَ قِيَـٰمًا لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّهْرَ ٱلْحَرَامَ وَٱلْهَدْىَ وَٱلْقَلَـٰٓئِدَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Know that GOD is strict in enforcing retribution, and that GOD is Forgiving, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The sole duty of the messenger is to deliver the message, and GOD knows everything you declare and everything you conceal.
arabic_uthmani: مَّا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Q., and the glorious Quran.*
arabic_uthmani: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Tall date palms, with clustered fruit.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Provisions for the people. And we revive with it dead lands; you are similarly resurrected.
arabic_uthmani: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, the dwellers of Russ, and Thamoud.
arabic_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And Aad, Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot.
arabic_uthmani: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And the dwellers of the woods, and the people of Tubba‘. All of them disbelieved the messengers and, consequently, My retribution befell them.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Were we too burdened by the first creation? Is this why they doubt resurrection?
arabic_uthmani: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We created the human, and we know what he whispers to himself. We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Two recording (angels), at right and at left, are constantly recording.
arabic_uthmani: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Not an utterance does he utter without an alert witness.
arabic_uthmani: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Finally, the inevitable coma of death comes; this is what you tried to evade.
arabic_uthmani: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They found it strange that a warner from among them came to them! The disbelievers said, “This is really strange.
arabic_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The horn is blown; this is the promised day.
arabic_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Every soul comes with a herder and a witness.
arabic_uthmani: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You used to be oblivious to this. We now remove your veil; today, your vision is (as strong as) steel.
arabic_uthmani: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The companion said, “Here is my formidable testimony.”*
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Throw into Gehenna every stubborn disbeliever.
arabic_uthmani: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Forbidder of charity, aggressor, full of doubt.
arabic_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He set up besides GOD another god Throw him into severe retribution.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: His companion said, “Our Lord, I did not mislead him; he was far astray.”
arabic_uthmani: قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He said, “Do not feud in front of Me I have sufficiently warned you.
arabic_uthmani: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “Nothing can be changed now. I am never unjust towards the people.”
arabic_uthmani: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: “After we die and become dust; this is impossible.”
arabic_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: That is the day when we ask Hell, “Have you had enough?” It will say, “Give me more.”
arabic_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Paradise will be offered to the righteous, readily.
arabic_uthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: This is what was promised to every repenter, steadfast.
arabic_uthmani: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They reverenced the Most Gracious, in their privacy, and came wholeheartedly.
arabic_uthmani: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Enter it in peace; this is the Day of Eternity.
arabic_uthmani: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They get anything they wish therein, and we have even more.
arabic_uthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Many a generation before them, who were more powerful, we annihilated. They searched the land; did they find an escape?
arabic_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: This should be a lesson for everyone who possesses a mind, or is able to hear and witness.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We have created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, and no fatigue touched us.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise, and before sunset.
arabic_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We are fully aware of any one of them who gets consumed by the earth; we have an accurate record.
arabic_uthmani: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: During the night you shall meditate on His name, and after prostrating.
arabic_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Prepare for the day when the caller calls from a place that is near.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When they hear the inevitable cry; that is the day you come out.
arabic_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ

english_1989: Surely, the charitable men and women, have loaned GOD a loan of goodness. They will receive their reward multiplied manifold; they have deserved a generous recompense.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَـٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَـٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who believed in GOD and His messengers are the saints and martyrs. Reserved for them at their Lord are their rewards and their light. As for those who disbelieved and rejected our revelations, they have incurred Hell.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. He controls life and death. He is Omnipotent.
arabic_uthmani: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Know that this worldly life is no more than play and games, and boasting among you, and hoarding of money and children. It is like abundant rain that produces plants and pleases the disbelievers. But then the plants turn into useless hay, and are blown away by the wind. In the Hereafter there is either severe retribution, or forgiveness from GOD and approval. This worldly life is no more than a temporary illusion.
arabic_uthmani: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَـٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَـٰمًا ۖ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ ۚ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Therefore, you shall race towards forgiveness from your Lord, and a Paradise whose width encompasses the heaven and the earth. It awaits those who believed in GOD and His messengers. Such is GOD’s grace that He bestows upon whomever He wills. GOD is Possessor of Infinite Grace.
arabic_uthmani: سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Anything that happens on earth, or to you, has already been recorded, even before the creation. This is easy for GOD to do.
arabic_uthmani: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Thus, you should not grieve over anything you miss, nor be proud of anything He has bestowed upon you. GOD does not love those who are boastful, proud.
arabic_uthmani: لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They are stingy, and enjoin the people to be stingy. If one turns away, then GOD is the Rich, the Praiseworthy.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبُخْلِ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We sent our messengers supported by clear proofs, and we sent down to them the scripture and the law, that the people may uphold justice. And we sent down the iron, wherein there is strength, and many benefits for the people. All this in order for GOD to distinguish those who would support Him and His messengers, on faith. GOD is Powerful, Almighty.
arabic_uthmani: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: We sent Noah and Abraham, and we granted their descendants prophethood and the scripture. Some of them were guided, while many were wicked.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدٍ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Subsequent to them, we sent our messengers. We sent Jesus the son of Mary, and we gave him the Injeel (Gospel), and we placed in the hearts of his followers kindness and mercy. But they invented hermitism which we never decreed for them. All we asked them to do was to uphold the commandments approved by GOD. But they did not uphold the message as they should have. Consequently, we gave those who believed among them their recompense, while many of them were wicked.
arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ٱبْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَـٰهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ رِضْوَٰنِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا ۖ فَـَٔاتَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, you shall reverence GOD and believe in His messenger. He will then grant you double the reward from His mercy, endow you with light to guide you, and forgive you. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Thus, the followers of previous scripture should know that they have not monopolized GOD’s mercy and grace, and that all grace is in GOD’s hand. He bestows it upon whomever He wills. GOD is Possessor of Infinite Grace.
arabic_uthmani: لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ مِّن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He is the Alpha and the Omega. He is the Outermost and the Innermost. He is fully aware of all things.
arabic_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّـٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days,* then assumed all authority. He knows everything that enters into the earth, and everything that comes out of it, and everything that comes down from the sky, and everything that climbs into it. He is with you wherever you may be. GOD is Seer of everything you do.
arabic_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. All matters are controlled by GOD.
arabic_uthmani: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
arabic_uthmani: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Believe in GOD and His messenger, and give from what He has bestowed upon you. Those among you who believe and give (to charity) have deserved a great recompense.
