english_1989: Among the Arabs around you, there are hypocrites, and among the city dwellers, there are those who are accustomed to hypocrisy. You do not know them, but we know them. We will double the retribution for them, then they end up committed to a terrible retribution.
arabic_uthmani: وَمِمَّنْ حَوْلَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ مُنَـٰفِقُونَ ۖ وَمِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ ۖ مَرَدُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنِّفَاقِ لَا تَعْلَمُهُمْ ۖ نَحْنُ نَعْلَمُهُمْ ۚ سَنُعَذِّبُهُم مَّرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ عَظِيمٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Others have confessed their sins, and have mixed good deeds with bad deeds. GOD may redeem them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: وَءَاخَرُونَ ٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ خَلَطُوا۟ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا وَءَاخَرَ سَيِّئًا عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Take from their money a charity to purify them and sanctify them. And encourage them, for your encouragement pleases them. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
arabic_uthmani: خُذْ مِنْ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ صَدَقَةً تُطَهِّرُهُمْ وَتُزَكِّيهِم بِهَا وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّ صَلَوٰتَكَ سَكَنٌ لَّهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do they not realize that GOD accepts the repentance of His worshipers, and takes the charities, and that GOD is the Redeemer, Most Merciful?
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَأْخُذُ ٱلصَّدَقَـٰتِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Work righteousness; GOD will see your work, and so will His messenger and the believers. Ultimately, you will be returned to the Knower of all secrets and declarations, then He will inform you of everything you had done.”
arabic_uthmani: وَقُلِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ فَسَيَرَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۖ وَسَتُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Others are waiting for GOD’s judgment; He may punish them, or He may redeem them. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: وَءَاخَرُونَ مُرْجَوْنَ لِأَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ إِمَّا يُعَذِّبُهُمْ وَإِمَّا يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: There are those who abuse the mosque by practicing disbelief, dividing the believers, and providing comfort to those who oppose GOD and His messenger. They swear: “Our intentions are honorable!” GOD bears witness that they are liars.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مَسْجِدًا ضِرَارًا وَكُفْرًا وَتَفْرِيقًۢا بَيْنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَإِرْصَادًا لِّمَنْ حَارَبَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ وَلَيَحْلِفُنَّ إِنْ أَرَدْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall never pray in such a mosque. A mosque that is established on the basis of righteousness from the first day is more worthy of your praying therein. In it, there are people who love to be purified. GOD loves those who purify themselves.
arabic_uthmani: لَا تَقُمْ فِيهِ أَبَدًا ۚ لَّمَسْجِدٌ أُسِّسَ عَلَى ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنْ أَوَّلِ يَوْمٍ أَحَقُّ أَن تَقُومَ فِيهِ ۚ فِيهِ رِجَالٌ يُحِبُّونَ أَن يَتَطَهَّرُوا۟ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُطَّهِّرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Is one who establishes his building on the basis of righteousness from GOD and His approval better, or one who establishes his building on the brink of a crumbling cliff, that falls down with him into the fire of Hell? GOD does not guide the transgressing people.
arabic_uthmani: أَفَمَنْ أَسَّسَ بُنْيَـٰنَهُۥ عَلَىٰ تَقْوَىٰ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٍ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّنْ أَسَّسَ بُنْيَـٰنَهُۥ عَلَىٰ شَفَا جُرُفٍ هَارٍ فَٱنْهَارَ بِهِۦ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If they repent and observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), then they are your brethren in religion. We thus explain the revelations for people who know.
arabic_uthmani: فَإِن تَابُوا۟ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ ۗ وَنُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Such a building that they have established remains a source of doubt in their hearts, until their hearts are stilled. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: لَا يَزَالُ بُنْيَـٰنُهُمُ ٱلَّذِى بَنَوْا۟ رِيبَةً فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ إِلَّآ أَن تَقَطَّعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD has bought from the believers their lives and their money in exchange for Paradise. Thus, they fight in the cause of GOD, willing to kill and get killed. Such is His truthful pledge in the Torah, the Gospel, and the Quran, and who fulfills His pledge better than GOD? You shall rejoice in making such an exchange. This is the greatest triumph.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱشْتَرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَمْوَٰلَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۚ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقْتُلُونَ وَيُقْتَلُونَ ۖ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَٱلْإِنجِيلِ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِعَهْدِهِۦ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَٱسْتَبْشِرُوا۟ بِبَيْعِكُمُ ٱلَّذِى بَايَعْتُم بِهِۦ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They are repenters, worshipers, praisers, meditators, bowing and prostrating, advocators of righteousness and forbidders of evil, and keepers of GOD’s laws. Give good news to such believers. You Shall Disown God’s Enemies
arabic_uthmani: ٱلتَّـٰٓئِبُونَ ٱلْعَـٰبِدُونَ ٱلْحَـٰمِدُونَ ٱلسَّـٰٓئِحُونَ ٱلرَّٰكِعُونَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدُونَ ٱلْءَامِرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَٱلنَّاهُونَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْحَـٰفِظُونَ لِحُدُودِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Neither the prophet, nor the believers shall ask forgiveness for the idol worshipers, even if they were their relatives, once they realize that they are destined for Hell.
arabic_uthmani: مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِىِّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن يَسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَلَوْ كَانُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى قُرْبَىٰ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The only reason Abraham asked forgiveness for his father was that he had promised him to do so. But, as soon as he realized that he was an enemy of GOD, he disowned him. Abraham was extremely kind, clement.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ ٱسْتِغْفَارُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ إِلَّا عَن مَّوْعِدَةٍ وَعَدَهَآ إِيَّاهُ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُۥٓ أَنَّهُۥ عَدُوٌّ لِّلَّهِ تَبَرَّأَ مِنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَأَوَّٰهٌ حَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD does not send any people astray, after He had guided them, without first pointing out for them what to expect. GOD is fully aware of all things.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِلَّ قَوْمًۢا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُبَيِّنَ لَهُم مَّا يَتَّقُونَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: To GOD belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. He grants life and death. You have none besides GOD as a Lord and Master.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۚ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD has redeemed the prophet, and the immigrants (Muhaajirin) and the supporters who gave them refuge (Ansaar), who followed him during the difficult times. That is when the hearts of some of them almost wavered. But He has redeemed them, for He is Compassionate towards them, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: لَّقَد تَّابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ وَٱلْأَنصَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ فِى سَاعَةِ ٱلْعُسْرَةِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا كَادَ يَزِيغُ قُلُوبُ فَرِيقٍ مِّنْهُمْ ثُمَّ تَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِهِمْ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Also (redeemed were) the three who stayed behind. The spacious earth became so straitened for them, that they almost gave up all hope for themselves. Finally, they realized that there was no escape from GOD, except to Him. He then redeemed them that they might repent. GOD is the Redeemer, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: وَعَلَى ٱلثَّلَـٰثَةِ ٱلَّذِينَ خُلِّفُوا۟ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَن لَّا مَلْجَأَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّآ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ تَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَتُوبُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, you shall observe GOD; you shall be among the truthful.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَكُونُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If they violate their oaths after pledging to keep their covenants, and attack your religion, then you may fight such leaders of paganism— you are no longer bound by your covenant with them— that they might refrain.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِن نَّكَثُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ عَهْدِهِمْ وَطَعَنُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ فَقَـٰتِلُوٓا۟ أَئِمَّةَ ٱلْكُفْرِ ۙ إِنَّهُمْ لَآ أَيْمَـٰنَ لَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَنتَهُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Neither the people of the city, nor the Arabs around them, shall seek to stay behind the messenger of GOD (when he mobilizes for war). Nor shall they give priority to their own affairs over supporting him. This is because they do not suffer any thirst, or any effort, or hunger in the cause of GOD, or make a single step that enrages the disbelievers, or inflict any hardship upon the enemy, without having it written down for them as a credit. GOD never fails to recompense those who work righteousness.
arabic_uthmani: مَا كَانَ لِأَهْلِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ أَن يَتَخَلَّفُوا۟ عَن رَّسُولِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَرْغَبُوا۟ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ لَا يُصِيبُهُمْ ظَمَأٌ وَلَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا مَخْمَصَةٌ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَطَـُٔونَ مَوْطِئًا يَغِيظُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَلَا يَنَالُونَ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ نَّيْلًا إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عَمَلٌ صَـٰلِحٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Nor do they incur any expense, small or large, nor do they cross any valley, without having it written down for them. GOD will surely reward them generously for their works.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا يُنفِقُونَ نَفَقَةً صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً وَلَا يَقْطَعُونَ وَادِيًا إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُمْ لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When the believers mobilize, not all of them shall do so. A few from each group shall mobilize by devoting their time to studying the religion. Thus, they can pass the knowledge on to their people when they return, that they may remain informed.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لِيَنفِرُوا۟ كَآفَّةً ۚ فَلَوْلَا نَفَرَ مِن كُلِّ فِرْقَةٍ مِّنْهُمْ طَآئِفَةٌ لِّيَتَفَقَّهُوا۟ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَلِيُنذِرُوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ إِذَا رَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَحْذَرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, you shall fight the disbelievers who attack you—let them find you stern— and know that GOD is with the righteous. The Hypocrites
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَـٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يَلُونَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ وَلْيَجِدُوا۟ فِيكُمْ غِلْظَةً ۚ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When a sura was revealed, some of them would say, “Did this sura strengthen the faith of any of you?” Indeed, it did strengthen the faith of those who believed, and they rejoice in such a revelation.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ أَيُّكُمْ زَادَتْهُ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ إِيمَـٰنًا ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَزَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَـٰنًا وَهُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: As for those who harbored doubts in their hearts, it actually added unholiness to their unholiness, and they died as disbelievers.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ فَزَادَتْهُمْ رِجْسًا إِلَىٰ رِجْسِهِمْ وَمَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do they not realize that they suffer from exacting trials every year— once or twice—yet, they consistently fail to repent, nor do they take heed? God Provides Irrefutable Evidence
arabic_uthmani: أَوَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُمْ يُفْتَنُونَ فِى كُلِّ عَامٍ مَّرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ لَا يَتُوبُونَ وَلَا هُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Whenever a sura was revealed, some of them would look at each other as if to say: “Does anyone see you?” Then they left. Thus, GOD has diverted their hearts, for they are people who do not comprehend.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ نَّظَرَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ هَلْ يَرَىٰكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ ثُمَّ ٱنصَرَفُوا۟ ۚ صَرَفَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُم بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Would you not fight people who have violated their oaths and tried to banish the messenger, and they are the ones who started the war in the first place? Are you afraid of them? GOD is the One you are supposed to fear, if you are believers.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَا تُقَـٰتِلُونَ قَوْمًا نَّكَثُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَهُمْ وَهَمُّوا۟ بِإِخْرَاجِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَهُم بَدَءُوكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۚ أَتَخْشَوْنَهُمْ ۚ فَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَوْهُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall fight them, for GOD will punish them at your hands, humiliate them, grant you victory over them, and cool the chests of the believers.
arabic_uthmani: قَـٰتِلُوهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْ وَيَنصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُّؤْمِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He will also remove the rage of the believers. GOD redeems whomever He wills. GOD Omniscient, Most Wise. The Inevitable Test
arabic_uthmani: وَيُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَيَتُوبُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Did you think that you will be left alone without GOD distinguishing those among you who strive, and never ally themselves with GOD enemies, or the enemies of His messenger, or the enemies of the believers? GOD is fully Cognizant o everything you do.
arabic_uthmani: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تُتْرَكُوا۟ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا رَسُولِهِۦ وَلَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلِيجَةً ۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The idol worshipers are not to frequent the mosques of GOD, while confessing their disbelief. Their works are utterly nullified, and they abide forever in Hell.
arabic_uthmani: مَا كَانَ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَن يَعْمُرُوا۟ مَسَـٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ شَـٰهِدِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِم بِٱلْكُفْرِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ وَفِى ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The only people to frequent the mosques of GOD are those who believe in GOD and the Last Day, and observe the contact prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and do not fear except GOD. These will surely be among the guided ones.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا يَعْمُرُ مَسَـٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَأَقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَى ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَلَمْ يَخْشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۖ فَعَسَىٰٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Have you considered the watering of the pilgrims and caring for the Sacred Mosque a substitute for believing in GOD and the Last Day, and striving in the cause of GOD? They are not equal in the sight of GOD. GOD does not guide the wicked people.
arabic_uthmani: أَجَعَلْتُمْ سِقَايَةَ ٱلْحَآجِّ وَعِمَارَةَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ كَمَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَجَـٰهَدَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوُۥنَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Therefore, roam the earth freely for four months, and know that you cannot escape from GOD, and that GOD humiliates the disbelievers.
arabic_uthmani: فَسِيحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِى ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْزِى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who believe, and emigrate, and strive in the cause of GOD with their money and their lives, are far greater in rank in the sight of GOD. These are the winners.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Their Lord gives them good news: mercy and approval from Him, and gardens where they enjoy an everlasting bliss.
arabic_uthmani: يُبَشِّرُهُمْ رَبُّهُم بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنْهُ وَرِضْوَٰنٍ وَجَنَّـٰتٍ لَّهُمْ فِيهَا نَعِيمٌ مُّقِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Eternally they abide therein. GOD possesses a great recompense.
arabic_uthmani: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, do not accept your parents and your siblings as allies, if they prefer to disbelieve instead of believing. Those among you who ally themselves with them are transgressing. Appreciating the Value of Faith
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَكُمْ وَإِخْوَٰنَكُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ إِنِ ٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْكُفْرَ عَلَى ٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “If your parents, your children, your siblings, your spouses, your family, the money you have earned, the business you worry about, and the homes you cherish are more beloved to you than GOD and His messenger, and the striving in His cause, then just wait until GOD brings His judgment.” GOD does not guide the wicked people.
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ إِن كَانَ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَأَبْنَآؤُكُمْ وَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ وَعَشِيرَتُكُمْ وَأَمْوَٰلٌ ٱقْتَرَفْتُمُوهَا وَتِجَـٰرَةٌ تَخْشَوْنَ كَسَادَهَا وَمَسَـٰكِنُ تَرْضَوْنَهَآ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَجِهَادٍ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD has granted you victory in many situations. But on the day of Hunayn, you became too proud of your number. Consequently, it did not help you at all, and the spacious earth became so straitened around you, that you turned around and fled.
arabic_uthmani: لَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى مَوَاطِنَ كَثِيرَةٍ ۙ وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ ۙ إِذْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ ثُمَّ وَلَّيْتُم مُّدْبِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Then GOD sent down contentment upon His messenger and upon the believers. And He sent down invisible soldiers; He thus punished those who disbelieved. This is the requital for the disbelievers.
arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَنزَلَ جُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَعَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: In the end, GOD redeems whomever He wills. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, the idol worshipers are impure; they shall not approach the Sacred Mosque after this year. If you fear loss of income, (you should know that) GOD will shower you with His provisions, in accordance with His will. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ نَجَسٌ فَلَا يَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ بَعْدَ عَامِهِمْ هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ عَيْلَةً فَسَوْفَ يُغْنِيكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِن شَآءَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall fight back against those who do not believe in GOD, nor in the Last Day, and they do not prohibit what GOD and His messenger have prohibited, and do not abide by the religion of truth among those who received the scripture, until they pay the due tax, peacefully.
arabic_uthmani: قَـٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَلَا بِٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَلَا يُحَرِّمُونَ مَا حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَلَا يَدِينُونَ دِينَ ٱلْحَقِّ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ حَتَّىٰ يُعْطُوا۟ ٱلْجِزْيَةَ عَن يَدٍ وَهُمْ صَـٰغِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: And a proclamation is herein issued from GOD and His messenger to all the people on the great day of pilgrimage, that GOD disowns the idol worshipers, and so does His messenger. Thus, if you repent, it would be better for you. But if you turn away, then know that you can not escape from GOD. Promise the disbelievers a painful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: وَأَذَٰنٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَجِّ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَرِىٓءٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ۙ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ۚ فَإِن تُبْتُمْ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِى ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The Jews said, “Ezra is the son of GOD,” while the Christians said, “Jesus is the son of GOD!” These are blasphemies that they utter with their lips. They thus match the blasphemies of those who have disbelieved in the past. GOD condemns them. They have certainly deviated.
arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ عُزَيْرٌ ٱبْنُ ٱللَّهِ وَقَالَتِ ٱلنَّصَـٰرَى ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ قَوْلُهُم بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ ۖ يُضَـٰهِـُٔونَ قَوْلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ قَـٰتَلَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They have set up their religious leaders and scholars as lords, instead of GOD. Others deified the Messiah, son of Mary. They were all commanded to worship only one god; there is no god except He. Be He glorified, high above having any partners.
arabic_uthmani: ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَرُهْبَـٰنَهُمْ أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَسِيحَ ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They want to put out GOD’s light with their mouths, but GOD insists upon perfecting His light, in spite of the disbelievers.
arabic_uthmani: يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُطْفِـُٔوا۟ نُورَ ٱللَّهِ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَيَأْبَى ٱللَّهُ إِلَّآ أَن يُتِمَّ نُورَهُۥ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: He is the One who sent His messenger* with the guidance and the religion of truth, and will make it dominate all other religions, despite the idol worshipers.
arabic_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, many religious leaders and nrp.arhers take the people’s money illicitly, and repel from the path of GOD. Those who hoard the gold and silver, and do not spend them in the cause of GOD, promise them a painful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْبَارِ وَٱلرُّهْبَانِ لَيَأْكُلُونَ أَمْوَٰلَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَكْنِزُونَ ٱلذَّهَبَ وَٱلْفِضَّةَ وَلَا يُنفِقُونَهَا فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The day will come when their gold and silver will be heated in the fire of Hell, then used to burn their foreheads, their sides, and their backs: “This is what you hoarded for yourselves, so taste what you have hoarded.”
arabic_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُحْمَىٰ عَلَيْهَا فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ فَتُكْوَىٰ بِهَا جِبَاهُهُمْ وَجُنُوبُهُمْ وَظُهُورُهُمْ ۖ هَـٰذَا مَا كَنَزْتُمْ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْنِزُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The count of months, as far as GOD is concerned, is twelve.* This has been GOD’s law, since the day He created the heavens and the earth. Four of them are sacred. This is the perfect religion; you shall not wrong your souls (by fighting) during the Sacred Months. However, you may declare all-out war against the idol worshipers (even during the Sacred Months), when they declare all-out war against you, and know that GOD is on the side of the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ عِدَّةَ ٱلشُّهُورِ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ مِنْهَآ أَرْبَعَةٌ حُرُمٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ ۚ فَلَا تَظْلِمُوا۟ فِيهِنَّ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ وَقَـٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ كَآفَّةً كَمَا يُقَـٰتِلُونَكُمْ كَآفَّةً ۚ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Altering the Sacred Months is an excessive blasphemy. For it causes those who disbelieved to be misled. They alternate the Sacred months and the regular months, while preserving the number of months made sacred by GOD. Thus, they violate what GOD made sacred. Their evil works are adorned in their eyes. GOD does not guide the disbelieving people.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّسِىٓءُ زِيَادَةٌ فِى ٱلْكُفْرِ ۖ يُضَلُّ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُحِلُّونَهُۥ عَامًا وَيُحَرِّمُونَهُۥ عَامًا لِّيُوَاطِـُٔوا۟ عِدَّةَ مَا حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ فَيُحِلُّوا۟ مَا حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ زُيِّنَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ أَعْمَـٰلِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you who believe, when you are told, “Mobilize in the cause of GOD,” why do you become heavily attached to the ground? Have you accepted this worldly life in place of the Hereafter? The materials of this world are nil, compared to the Hereafter.
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَا لَكُمْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمُ ٱنفِرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ٱثَّاقَلْتُمْ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ أَرَضِيتُم بِٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مِنَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ فَمَا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Unless you mobilize, He will commit you to painful retribution, and substitute other people in your place; you never hurt Him in the least. GOD is Omnipotent.
arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا تَنفِرُوا۟ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا وَيَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّوهُ شَيْـًٔا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If the idol worshipers sign a peace treaty with you, and do not violate it, nor band together with others against you, you shall fulfill your treaty with them, until the expiration date. GOD loves the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ عَـٰهَدتُّم مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنقُصُوكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَمْ يُظَـٰهِرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ أَحَدًا فَأَتِمُّوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ عَهْدَهُمْ إِلَىٰ مُدَّتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you fail to support (the messenger), GOD is already supporting him. Thus, when the disbelievers chased him, and he was one of two in the cave, he said to his friend, “Do not worry; GOD is with us.” GOD then sent down contentment and security upon him, and supported him with invisible soldiers. He made the word of the disbelievers lowly, while GOD’s word reigns supreme. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدْ نَصَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِذْ أَخْرَجَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ثَانِىَ ٱثْنَيْنِ إِذْ هُمَا فِى ٱلْغَارِ إِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَـٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَا ۖ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ وَأَيَّدَهُۥ بِجُنُودٍ لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَجَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلسُّفْلَىٰ ۗ وَكَلِمَةُ ٱللَّهِ هِىَ ٱلْعُلْيَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall readily mobilize, light or heavy, and strive with your money and your lives in the cause of GOD. This is better for you, if you only knew.
arabic_uthmani: ٱنفِرُوا۟ خِفَافًا وَثِقَالًا وَجَـٰهِدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If there were a quick material gain, and a short journey, they would have followed you. But the journey was just too long for them. They will swear by GOD: “If we could, we would have mobilized with you.” They thus hurt themselves, and GOD knows that they are liars.
arabic_uthmani: لَوْ كَانَ عَرَضًا قَرِيبًا وَسَفَرًا قَاصِدًا لَّٱتَّبَعُوكَ وَلَـٰكِنۢ بَعُدَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلشُّقَّةُ ۚ وَسَيَحْلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ لَوِ ٱسْتَطَعْنَا لَخَرَجْنَا مَعَكُمْ يُهْلِكُونَ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD has pardoned you (O Muhammad); why did you give them permission (to stay behind), before you could distinguish those who are truthful from the liars?
arabic_uthmani: عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنكَ لِمَ أَذِنتَ لَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَتَعْلَمَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who believe in GOD and the Last Day do not ask your permission to evade the opportunity of striving with their money and their lives. GOD is fully aware of the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: لَا يَسْتَـْٔذِنُكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ أَن يُجَـٰهِدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The only people who wish to be excused are those who do not really believe in GOD and the Last Day. Their hearts are full of doubt, and their doubts cause them to waver.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا يَسْتَـْٔذِنُكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَٱرْتَابَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِى رَيْبِهِمْ يَتَرَدَّدُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Had they really wanted to mobilize, they would have prepared for it thoroughly. But GOD disliked their participation, so He discouraged them; they were told, “Stay behind with those who are staying behind.”
arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا۟ ٱلْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا۟ لَهُۥ عُدَّةً وَلَـٰكِن كَرِهَ ٱللَّهُ ٱنۢبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ وَقِيلَ ٱقْعُدُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلْقَـٰعِدِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Had they mobilized with you, they would have created confusion, and would have caused disputes and divisions among you. Some of you were apt to listen to them. GOD is fully aware of the evildoers.
arabic_uthmani: لَوْ خَرَجُوا۟ فِيكُم مَّا زَادُوكُمْ إِلَّا خَبَالًا وَلَأَوْضَعُوا۟ خِلَـٰلَكُمْ يَبْغُونَكُمُ ٱلْفِتْنَةَ وَفِيكُمْ سَمَّـٰعُونَ لَهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They sought to spread chaos among you in the past, and confounded matters for you. However, the truth ultimately prevailed, and GOD’s judgment was issued, in spite of them.
arabic_uthmani: لَقَدِ ٱبْتَغَوُا۟ ٱلْفِتْنَةَ مِن قَبْلُ وَقَلَّبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأُمُورَ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَظَهَرَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَهُمْ كَـٰرِهُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Some of them would say, “Give me permission (to stay behind)-, do not impose such a hardship on me.” In fact, they have thus incurred a terrible hardship; Hell is surrounding such disbelievers.
arabic_uthmani: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ ٱئْذَن لِّى وَلَا تَفْتِنِّىٓ ۚ أَلَا فِى ٱلْفِتْنَةِ سَقَطُوا۟ ۗ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌۢ بِٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Once the Sacred Months are past, (and they refuse to make peace) you may kill the idol worshipers when you encounter them, punish them, and resist every move they make. If they repent and observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), you shall let them go. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنسَلَخَ ٱلْأَشْهُرُ ٱلْحُرُمُ فَٱقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ حَيْثُ وَجَدتُّمُوهُمْ وَخُذُوهُمْ وَٱحْصُرُوهُمْ وَٱقْعُدُوا۟ لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ ۚ فَإِن تَابُوا۟ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ فَخَلُّوا۟ سَبِيلَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If something good happens to you, they hurt, and if an affliction befalls you, they say, “We told you so,” as they turn away rejoicing.
arabic_uthmani: إِن تُصِبْكَ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْكَ مُصِيبَةٌ يَقُولُوا۟ قَدْ أَخَذْنَآ أَمْرَنَا مِن قَبْلُ وَيَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّهُمْ فَرِحُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Nothing happens to us, except what GOD has decreed for us. He is our Lord and Master. In GOD the believers shall trust.”
arabic_uthmani: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَآ إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَىٰنَا ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “You can only expect for us one of two good things (victory or martyrdom), while we expect for you condemnation from GOD and retribution from Him, or at our hands. Therefore, wait, and we will wait along with you.”
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ هَلْ تَرَبَّصُونَ بِنَآ إِلَّآ إِحْدَى ٱلْحُسْنَيَيْنِ ۖ وَنَحْنُ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِكُمْ أَن يُصِيبَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِعَذَابٍ مِّنْ عِندِهِۦٓ أَوْ بِأَيْدِينَا ۖ فَتَرَبَّصُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّتَرَبِّصُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Say, “Spend, willingly or unwillingly. Nothing will be accepted from you, for you are evil people.” Rejectors of God’s Messenger Observed the Salat Prayers*
arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أَنفِقُوا۟ طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا لَّن يُتَقَبَّلَ مِنكُمْ ۖ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: What prevented the acceptance of their spending is that they disbelieved in GOD and His messenger, and when they observed the contact prayers (Salat),* they observed them lazily, and when they gave to charity, they did so grudgingly.
arabic_uthmani: وَمَا مَنَعَهُمْ أَن تُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ نَفَقَـٰتُهُمْ إِلَّآ أَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَبِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلَا يَأْتُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ إِلَّا وَهُمْ كُسَالَىٰ وَلَا يُنفِقُونَ إِلَّا وَهُمْ كَـٰرِهُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do not be impressed by their money, or their children. GOD turns these into means of retribution for them in this life, and their souls depart while they are disbelievers.
arabic_uthmani: فَلَا تُعْجِبْكَ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُم بِهَا فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَتَزْهَقَ أَنفُسُهُمْ وَهُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They swear by GOD that they belong with you, while they do not belong with you; they are divisive people.
arabic_uthmani: وَيَحْلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُمْ لَمِنكُمْ وَمَا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ يَفْرَقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If they could find any refuge, or caves, or a hiding place, they would go to it, rushing.
arabic_uthmani: لَوْ يَجِدُونَ مَلْجَـًٔا أَوْ مَغَـٰرَٰتٍ أَوْ مُدَّخَلًا لَّوَلَّوْا۟ إِلَيْهِ وَهُمْ يَجْمَحُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Some of them criticize your distribution of the charities; if they are given therefrom, they become satisfied, but if they are not given therefrom, they become objectors.
arabic_uthmani: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَلْمِزُكَ فِى ٱلصَّدَقَـٰتِ فَإِنْ أُعْطُوا۟ مِنْهَا رَضُوا۟ وَإِن لَّمْ يُعْطَوْا۟ مِنْهَآ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْخَطُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They should be satisfied with what GOD and His messenger have given them. They should have said, “GOD suffices us. GOD will provide for us from His bounties, through his messenger. We are seeking only GOD.”
arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ رَضُوا۟ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَقَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ سَيُؤْتِينَا ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ رَٰغِبُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If one of the idol worshipers sought safe passage with you, you shall grant him safe passage, so that he can hear the word of GOD, then send him back to his place of security. That is because they are people who do not know.
arabic_uthmani: وَإِنْ أَحَدٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ٱسْتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرْهُ حَتَّىٰ يَسْمَعَ كَلَـٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَبْلِغْهُ مَأْمَنَهُۥ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Charities shall go to the poor, the needy, the workers who collect them, the new converts, to free the slaves, to those burdened by sudden expenses, in the cause of GOD, and to the traveling alien. Such is GOD’s commandment. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا ٱلصَّدَقَـٰتُ لِلْفُقَرَآءِ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينِ وَٱلْعَـٰمِلِينَ عَلَيْهَا وَٱلْمُؤَلَّفَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَفِى ٱلرِّقَابِ وَٱلْغَـٰرِمِينَ وَفِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۖ فَرِيضَةً مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Some of them hurt the prophet by saying, “He is all ears!” Say, “It is better for you that he listens to you. He believes in GOD, and trusts the believers. He is a mercy for those among you who believe.” Those who hurt GOD’s messenger have incurred a painful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: وَمِنْهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ ٱلنَّبِىَّ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ أُذُنٌ ۚ قُلْ أُذُنُ خَيْرٍ لَّكُمْ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَيُؤْمِنُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They swear by GOD to you, to please you, when GOD and His messenger are more worthy of pleasing, if they are really believers.
arabic_uthmani: يَحْلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ لِيُرْضُوكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ أَحَقُّ أَن يُرْضُوهُ إِن كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Did they not know that anyone who opposes GOD and His messenger has incurred the fire of Hell forever? This is the worst humiliation.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ مَن يُحَادِدِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَأَنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدًا فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخِزْىُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The hypocrites worry that a sura may be revealed exposing what is inside their hearts. Say, “Go ahead and mock. GOD will bring out what you are worried about.”
arabic_uthmani: يَحْذَرُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ أَن تُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُورَةٌ تُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ قُلِ ٱسْتَهْزِءُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْرِجٌ مَّا تَحْذَرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If you ask them, they would say, “We were only mocking and playing.” Say, “Do you realize that you are mocking GOD and His revelations, and His messenger?”
arabic_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّمَا كُنَّا نَخُوضُ وَنَلْعَبُ ۚ قُلْ أَبِٱللَّهِ وَءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَرَسُولِهِۦ كُنتُمْ تَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do not apologize. You have disbelieved after having believed. If we pardon some of you, we will punish others among you, as a consequence of their transgressions.
arabic_uthmani: لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ قَدْ كَفَرْتُم بَعْدَ إِيمَـٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِن نَّعْفُ عَن طَآئِفَةٍ مِّنكُمْ نُعَذِّبْ طَآئِفَةًۢ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The hypocrite men and the hypocrite women belong with each other—they advocate evil and prohibit righteousness, and they are stingy. They forgot GOD, so He forgot them The hypocrites are truly wicked.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتُ بَعْضُهُم مِّنۢ بَعْضٍ ۚ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمُنكَرِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَقْبِضُونَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ ۚ نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَنَسِيَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD promises the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women, as well as the disbelievers, the fire of Hell. They abide therein forever. It suffices them. GOD has condemned them; they have incurred an unending retribution.
arabic_uthmani: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتِ وَٱلْكُفَّارَ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ هِىَ حَسْبُهُمْ ۚ وَلَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Some of those before you were stronger than you, and possessed more money and children. They rejoiced in their material possessions. You have rejoiced in your material possessions, just like those before you have rejoiced. And you are totally preoccupied therewith, just as they were preoccupied. Such are those who nullify their works, both in this world and in the Hereafter; they are the losers.
arabic_uthmani: كَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنكُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَكْثَرَ أَمْوَٰلًا وَأَوْلَـٰدًا فَٱسْتَمْتَعُوا۟ بِخَلَـٰقِهِمْ فَٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِخَلَـٰقِكُمْ كَمَا ٱسْتَمْتَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُم بِخَلَـٰقِهِمْ وَخُضْتُمْ كَٱلَّذِى خَاضُوٓا۟ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: How can the idol worshipers demand any pledge from GOD and from His messenger? Exempted are those who did enter into a peace treaty with you at the Sacred Mosque. If they honor and uphold such an agreement, you shall uphold it as well. GOD loves the righteous.
arabic_uthmani: كَيْفَ يَكُونُ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَهْدٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ رَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ عَـٰهَدتُّمْ عِندَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ۖ فَمَا ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱسْتَقِيمُوا۟ لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Have they not learned anything from those before them such as the people of Noah, ‘Aad, Thamood, the people of Abraham, the dwellers of Midyan, and the evildoers (of Sodom and Gomorrah)? Their messengers went to them with clear proofs. GOD never wronged them; they are the ones who wronged their own souls.
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَأْتِهِمْ نَبَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَقَوْمِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَأَصْحَـٰبِ مَدْيَنَ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتِ ۚ أَتَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The believing men and women are allies of one another. They advocate righteousness and forbid evil, they observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and they obey GOD and His messenger. These will be showered by GOD’s mercy. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَيُطِيعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ سَيَرْحَمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD promises the believing men and the believing women gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever, and good homes in the gardens of Eden. And GOD’s approval is even better. This is the greatest triumph.
arabic_uthmani: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَمَسَـٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فِى جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ۚ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: O you prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern in dealing with them. Their destiny is Hell; what a miserable abode!
arabic_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ جَـٰهِدِ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They swear by GOD that they never said it, although they have uttered the word of disbelief; they have disbelieved after being Muslims. Actually, they gave up what they never had. They have rebelled after GOD and His messenger have showered them with His grace and provisions. If they repent, it would be best for them. But if they turn away, GOD will commit them to painful retribution in this life and in the Hereafter; they will find no one on earth to be their ally or supporter.
arabic_uthmani: يَحْلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ مَا قَالُوا۟ وَلَقَدْ قَالُوا۟ كَلِمَةَ ٱلْكُفْرِ وَكَفَرُوا۟ بَعْدَ إِسْلَـٰمِهِمْ وَهَمُّوا۟ بِمَا لَمْ يَنَالُوا۟ ۚ وَمَا نَقَمُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ أَنْ أَغْنَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ ۚ فَإِن يَتُوبُوا۟ يَكُ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَتَوَلَّوْا۟ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Some of them even pledged: “If GOD showered us with His grace, we would be charitable, and would lead a righteous life.”
arabic_uthmani: وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ عَـٰهَدَ ٱللَّهَ لَئِنْ ءَاتَىٰنَا مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَنَصَّدَّقَنَّ وَلَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: But when He did shower them with His grace, they became stingy, and turned away in aversion.
arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ بَخِلُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Consequently, He plagued them with hypocrisy in their hearts, till the day they meet Him. This is because they broke their promises to GOD, and because they lied.
arabic_uthmani: فَأَعْقَبَهُمْ نِفَاقًا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يَلْقَوْنَهُۥ بِمَآ أَخْلَفُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا وَعَدُوهُ وَبِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْذِبُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Did they not know that GOD knows their secrets, as well as their declarations; that GOD is the Knower of all secrets?
arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Those who criticize the generous believers for giving too much, and ridicule the poor believers for giving too little, GOD despises them. They have incurred a painful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَلْمِزُونَ ٱلْمُطَّوِّعِينَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِى ٱلصَّدَقَـٰتِ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ إِلَّا جُهْدَهُمْ فَيَسْخَرُونَ مِنْهُمْ ۙ سَخِرَ ٱللَّهُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: How can they (demand a pledge) when they never observed any rights of relationship between you and them, nor any covenant, if they ever had a chance to prevail. They pacified you with lip service, while their hearts were in opposition. Indeed, most of them are wicked.
arabic_uthmani: كَيْفَ وَإِن يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا يَرْقُبُوا۟ فِيكُمْ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً ۚ يُرْضُونَكُم بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتَأْبَىٰ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Whether you ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them— even if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times—GOD will not forgive their This is because they disbelieved in GOD and His messenger. GOD does not guide the wicked people.
arabic_uthmani: ٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ أَوْ لَا تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ إِن تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً فَلَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The sedentary rejoiced in their staying behind the messenger of GOD; they hated to strive with their money and their lives in the cause of GOD. They said, “Let us not mobilize in this heat!” Say, “The fire of Hell is much hotter,” if they could only comprehend.
arabic_uthmani: فَرِحَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ بِمَقْعَدِهِمْ خِلَـٰفَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَرِهُوٓا۟ أَن يُجَـٰهِدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَنفِرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَرِّ ۗ قُلْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ أَشَدُّ حَرًّا ۚ لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَفْقَهُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Let them laugh a little and cry a lot. This is the requital for their sins.
arabic_uthmani: فَلْيَضْحَكُوا۟ قَلِيلًا وَلْيَبْكُوا۟ كَثِيرًا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: If GOD returned you to a situation where they ask your permission to mobilize with you, you should say, “You will never again mobilize with me, nor will you ever fight with me against any enemy. For you have chosen to be with the sedentary in the first place. Therefore, you must stay with the sedentary.”
arabic_uthmani: فَإِن رَّجَعَكَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَىٰ طَآئِفَةٍ مِّنْهُمْ فَٱسْتَـْٔذَنُوكَ لِلْخُرُوجِ فَقُل لَّن تَخْرُجُوا۟ مَعِىَ أَبَدًا وَلَن تُقَـٰتِلُوا۟ مَعِىَ عَدُوًّا ۖ إِنَّكُمْ رَضِيتُم بِٱلْقُعُودِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ فَٱقْعُدُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلْخَـٰلِفِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: You shall not observe the funeral prayer for any of them when he dies, nor shall you stand at his grave. They have disbelieved in GOD and His messenger, and died in a state of wickedness.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تُصَلِّ عَلَىٰٓ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُم مَّاتَ أَبَدًا وَلَا تَقُمْ عَلَىٰ قَبْرِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَمَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Do not be impressed by their money or children; GOD punishes them therewith in this world, then their souls depart as disbelievers.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تُعْجِبْكَ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَأَوْلَـٰدُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُعَذِّبَهُم بِهَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَتَزْهَقَ أَنفُسُهُمْ وَهُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: When a sura is revealed, stating: “Believe in GOD, and strive with His messenger,” even the strong among them say, “Let us stay behind!”
arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَجَـٰهِدُوا۟ مَعَ رَسُولِهِ ٱسْتَـْٔذَنَكَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلطَّوْلِ مِنْهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ ذَرْنَا نَكُن مَّعَ ٱلْقَـٰعِدِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They chose to be with the sedentary. Consequently, their hearts were sealed. Thus, they cannot comprehend.
arabic_uthmani: رَضُوا۟ بِأَن يَكُونُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلْخَوَالِفِ وَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: As for the messenger and those who believed with him, they eagerly strive with their money and their lives. These have deserved all the good things; they are the winners.
arabic_uthmani: لَـٰكِنِ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتُ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: GOD has prepared for them gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. This is the greatest triumph.
arabic_uthmani: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They traded away GOD’s revelations for a cheap price. Consequently, they repulsed the people from His path. Miserable indeed is what they did!
arabic_uthmani: ٱشْتَرَوْا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The Arabs made up excuses, and came to you seeking permission to stay behind. Such is the conse quence of their rejection of GOD and His messenger—they stayed behind. Indeed, those who dis believed among them have incurred a painful retribution.
arabic_uthmani: وَجَآءَ ٱلْمُعَذِّرُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ لِيُؤْذَنَ لَهُمْ وَقَعَدَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ ۚ سَيُصِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Not to be blamed are those who are weak, or ill, or do not find anything to offer, so long as they remain devoted to GOD and His messenger. The righteous among them shall not be blamed. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
arabic_uthmani: لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلضُّعَفَآءِ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرْضَىٰ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ مَا يُنفِقُونَ حَرَجٌ إِذَا نَصَحُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ مَا عَلَى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ مِن سَبِيلٍ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Also excused are those who come to you wishing to be included with you, but you tell them, “I do not have anything to carry you on.” They then turn back with tears in their eyes, genuinely saddened that they could not afford to contribute.
arabic_uthmani: وَلَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا مَآ أَتَوْكَ لِتَحْمِلَهُمْ قُلْتَ لَآ أَجِدُ مَآ أَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ تَوَلَّوا۟ وَّأَعْيُنُهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمْعِ حَزَنًا أَلَّا يَجِدُوا۟ مَا يُنفِقُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The blame is on those who ask your permission to stay behind, even though they have no excuse. They have chosen to be with the sedentary and, consequently, GOD has sealed their hearts. Thus, they do not know.
arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُونَكَ وَهُمْ أَغْنِيَآءُ ۚ رَضُوا۟ بِأَن يَكُونُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلْخَوَالِفِ وَطَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They apologize to you after you come back (from battle). Say, “Do not apologize; we no longer believe you. GOD has exposed you for us.” GOD will see your works, and so will the messenger, then you will be returned to the Knower of all secrets and declarations, and He will inform you of everything you had done.
arabic_uthmani: يَعْتَذِرُونَ إِلَيْكُمْ إِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ قُل لَّا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكُمْ قَدْ نَبَّأَنَا ٱللَّهُ مِنْ أَخْبَارِكُمْ ۚ وَسَيَرَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They will swear by GOD to you, after you come back, that you may disregard them. Do disregard them. They are condemned, and their destiny is Hell as a requital for what they earned.
arabic_uthmani: سَيَحْلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ إِذَا ٱنقَلَبْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لِتُعْرِضُوا۟ عَنْهُمْ ۖ فَأَعْرِضُوا۟ عَنْهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ رِجْسٌ ۖ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: They swear to you, in order to please you. Even if you are pleased with them, GOD is never pleased with the wicked people.
arabic_uthmani: يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ لِتَرْضَوْا۟ عَنْهُمْ ۖ فَإِن تَرْضَوْا۟ عَنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَرْضَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: The Arabs are the worst in disbelief and hypocrisy, and the most likely to ignore the laws that GOD has revealed to His messenger. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
arabic_uthmani: ٱلْأَعْرَابُ أَشَدُّ كُفْرًا وَنِفَاقًا وَأَجْدَرُ أَلَّا يَعْلَمُوا۟ حُدُودَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
arabic_alignment_note: Canonical Uthmani transcription aligned to the Arabic facsimile panel on this page; ornamental glyph layout is preserved only in the source scan.

english_1989: Some Arabs consider their spending (in the cause of God) to be a loss, and even wait in anticipation that a disaster may hit you. It is they who will incur the worst disaster. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
arabic_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ مَن يَتَّخِذُ مَا يُنفِقُ مَغْرَمًا وَيَتَرَبَّصُ بِكُمُ ٱلدَّوَآئِرَ ۚ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
